Further, it exports its products. The company was formerly known as Bharat Earth Movers Limited. BEML Limited was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

BELRISE.NS.longBusinessSummary: Belrise Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells automotive parts and components of two-wheeler, three-wheeler and four-wheeler passenger and commercial vehicles in India. The company offers shock absorber springs, rear and front shock absorbers, plastic and seat cowls, side dashboards, steering columns, head lamp brackets, front fenders, exhaust systems, foot rests, brake pedals, hub motors, main and side stands, chassis, front fork assembly, two-wheeler chassis sub-assemblies, BIW parts, plastic accessories, seating system parts, polymer parts, cross car beams, battery containers, air tanks, and bumpers. It also provides polymer refrigerator parts, such as fruit and vegetable trays, handles, and bases; and renewable parts, including solar panel components. In addition, the company offers press parts; two-wheeler fairings, seat and side covers, luggage boxes, helmets, and headlight housings; outer and inner rear-view mirrors for vehicles; wishbone assemblies; tri hexavalent nickel chrome plating of mild and stainless steel; automotive systems comprising clutch and pressure plates, flywheels, control arms, crankshafts, housings, hubs, and calipers; home appliances consisting of freezer grills, fridge baskets, and thermostat parts; and home security devices, including household locks and bolts, as well as operates a rose plantation. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Badve Engineering Limited and changed its name to Belrise Industries Limited in August 2022. Belrise Industries Limited was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Pune, India.

BENARAS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Benares Hotels Limited operates hotels in India. It operates hotels under the Taj Ganges and Taj Nadesar Palace names in Varanasi and The Ginger Hotel name in Gondia, Maharashtra. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

BENGALASM.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bengal & Assam Company Limited operates as an investment company in India and internationally. It is also involved in the investment in securities; and trading of goods. The company was formerly known as Bengal & Assam Investors Limited and changed its name to Bengal & Assam Company Limited in June 1982. Bengal & Assam Company Limited was incorporated in 1947 and is based in New Delhi, India.

BERGEPAINT.NS.longBusinessSummary: Berger Paints India Limited manufactures and sells paints in India and internationally. The company offers interior wall coatings, including designer finishes, interior emulsions, and ceiling paints; exterior wall coatings comprising exterior emulsions and textures, and roof and floor coatings; putty and cement paints; solvent, interior, exterior, metal, and wood primers; enamels; wood finishes; waterproofing solutions; and tiling solutions. It also provides acrylic, silicate, and mineral plasters; thermal insulation adhesives; mortars; ready to use coat, wood effect, ribbed effect, concrete effect, and 3D effect; gel adhesives for ceramic tile flooring. The company was formerly known as British Paints (India) Limited and changed its name to Berger Paints India Limited in December 1983. The company was incorporated in 1923 and is based in Kolkata, India. Berger Paints India Limited operates as a subsidiary of U. K. Paints India Private Limited.

BEPL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited operates a petrochemical company in India and internationally. The company manufactures and sells thermoplastic resins that include acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS) and styrene acrylate (SAN) resins. Its products include general purpose, heat resistant, flame retardant, and extrusion ABS resins for automobiles, home appliances, television, electronics, healthcare, kitchen appliances, and stationery items and toys. The company also provides weather resistance acrylonitrile styrene acrylate (ASA) resins. In addition, it offers specialized grade tailor made products for metallic specialty, pearl specialty, low gloss specialty, ASA/PMMA, and ABS/PMMA applications. Further, the company engages in trading activities. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BETA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Beta Drugs Limited develops, manufactures, and sells anti-cancer bulk drugs and finished dosages in India. The company offers cosmeceutical and oncology products. It also manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) and pharmaceutical formulation intermediates (PFI). The company exports its products. Beta Drugs Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Panchkula, India.

BESTAGRO.NS.longBusinessSummary: Best Agrolife Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of agrochemical products in India and internationally. It offers insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, public-health, and plant growth regulator (PGR) products in the form of technical, intermediates, and novel formulations. The company also offers Ronfen, and insecticide; Nemagen, a novel insecticide combination; Defender, a dual-action insecticide + fungicide in WG form; Orisulam, a breakthrough herbicidal composition (GR formulation); Tricolor, a potent fungicidal formulation; and Warden Extra, a ternary SC formulation offering broad-spectrum control. In addition, it provides Tombo, a new generation corn herbicide; Azaro, a novel pre-emergence herbicide; Best Man, a deep-reaching translaminar power insecticide; Fetagen, a triple action shield, next generation insecticide; Citigen, first to launch in India post innovator; Shot Down, an comprehensive solution for the effective control of a wide range of weeds and Propique, registration-based herbicide. Further, the company offers Fluzam, a patented triple-action seed treatment; Midcotin; Cubax Power Extra, an enhanced formulation developed to improve product performance and farmer convenience; and Trishanku, next-generation formulation. It offers its products through a network of distributors. The company was formerly known as Sahyog Multibase Limited and changed its name to Best Agrolife Limited in October 2019. Best Agrolife Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in New Delhi, India.

BFINVEST.NS.longBusinessSummary: BF Investment Limited engages in investment and financing businesses in India. BF Investment Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Pune, India.

BGRENERGY.NS.longBusinessSummary: BGR Energy Systems Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells capital equipment for power plants, petrochemical and process industries, and refineries in India and internationally. The company is involved in the provision of turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction services for power plants; supply of sub and super critical steam turbines and generators, and single and multiple pressure level natural circulation heat recovery steam generators; and providing process coolers, finned tubes, radiator and compressors coolers, and tube bundles. It also offers turnkey solutions for EHV substations; optical fiber composite ground wire and optical line termination equipment; gas insulated switchgear substations; EHV transmission lines; plant electrical projects; and rural electrification, as well as power trading and balance of plant works for hydro projects. In addition, the company provides process equipment packages and systems, including phase separator system / skids, indirect water bath heater, gas conditioning, regulating and metering systems, knockout drums / scrubbers, and filter separators / dry gas filters; pipeline equipment; compressor packaging products; and storage tanks; deaerators, membrane based water treatment plant, desalination, demineralization plants, effluent treatment and recycling plants, and condensate polishing units. In addition, it operates thermal power projects at Andhra Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh. BGR Energy Systems Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Chennai, India.

BFUTILITIE.NS.longBusinessSummary: BF Utilities Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the infrastructure business in India. The company develops the Bangalore Mysore Infrastructure Corridor Project and operates a 30 kilometers bypass road connecting the twin cities of Hubli and Dharwad in North Karnataka. In addition, the company involved in electricity generation through windmills. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Pune, India.

BHAGCHEM.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bhagiradha Chemicals & Industries Limited manufactures and sells crop protection chemicals in India, rest of Asia, and Europe. The company offers insecticides, such as chlorpyrifos, chlorpyrifos-methyl, diafenthiuron, fipronil, dinotefuran, thiamethoxam, imidacloprid, pymetrozine, and chlorantraniliprole; fungicides, including azoxystrobin and trifloxystrobin; herbicides comprising triclopyr, cloquintocet-mexyl, clodinafop-propargyl, sulfosulfuron, and pinoxaden; and specialty intermediates consisting of 2,6-dichloroaniline and 2-ethylsulfonylimidazo pyridine-3-sulfonamide. It serves agrochemical manufacturers and pesticide formulators and traders. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

BHAGERIA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bhageria Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and trades specialty dyes and dye intermediates in India and internationally. It operates through Chemicals, Solar Power, Pharma, and Others segments. The company offers organic and inorganic chemicals, such as pigment and pigment intermediates, dyestuffs, h-acid, gamma acid, and vinyl sulphone. It also generates and distributes solar power; produces active pharmaceutical ingredients; and engages in trading activities, as well as engineering, procurement, and commissioning/construction contractor services. The company exports its products to Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Bahrain, Indonesia, China, Thailand, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan. It serves various sectors, including electronics and IT, food, textile and leather, paint and coatings, construction and infrastructure, and healthcare. The company was formerly known as Bhageria Dye Chem Limited and changed its name to Bhageria Industries Limited in May 2015. Bhageria Industries Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BHAGYANGR.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bhagyanagar India Limited manufactures and distributes copper products in India. The company offers copper bus bars, wires and rods, foils and sheets, nuggets, tubes and pipes, paper insulated copper conductors, enameled strips and wires, continuous transpose conductors, and yoke assembly and solenoid switch products. It also provides solar flat plate collectors, solar fins, field coils and armature pins, and solar interconnect wires. In addition, the company operates 9 MW of wind power capacity. It serves automotive, switchgear, transformer, and other electrical industries. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Bhagyanagar Metals Ltd. and changed its name to Bhagyanagar India Limited in September 2006. Bhagyanagar India Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Secunderabad, India.

BHARATCOAL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharat Coking Coal Limited produces and sells coal in India. The company offers coking coal, non-coking coal, and washed coking and power coal products, as well as rejects and slurries. Its products are used in power, steel, cement, fertilizer, and glass manufacturing applications. The company serves the power and non-power sectors. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Dhanbad, India. Bharat Coking Coal Limited operates as a subsidiary of Coal India Limited.

BHARATFORG.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharat Forge Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of forged and machined components in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Forgings, Defence, and Others. The company offers automotive components comprising crankshafts, connecting rods, emission/after treatment, and fuel injection systems; chassis, such as front axle beams, steering knuckles, control arms, knuckle, forks, and reinforcement brackets; transmission and driveline components; and power generation components for thermal, hydro, and wind energy. It provides oil and gas forging products, such as subsea, surface, and drilling components; rail products, including engine and bogie components, turbochargers, and power electronics; and marine products that include propellers, marine motor, stern tube, crankshaft, conrod, piston rod, stock, trunk, and pintle. In addition, the company offers various components, such as turbochargers and superchargers, rotor assembly, and air cycle machine for land, marine, and aviation application; construction and mining products, including machined crankshafts, injector bodies, front spindles, and track links; and e-mobility, castings, and defense products. Further, it provides aerostructures, landing gear, and critical engine components. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Pune, India.

BHARATGEAR.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharat Gears Limited manufactures and supplies automotive gear in India, the United States, Mexico, Spain, and internationally. The company provides gear products, such as ring gears, pinions, transmission gears, shafts, differential gears, and bevel gears; automotive components, including automotive clutch assemblies and components, turbochargers and related parts, driveline products, axle shafts, flywheel assemblies and rings, propeller shaft components, U-J Cross, steering components, differential cages, steel wheel rims, turbocharger core and rotor, ST. Bevel, ceramic button, and break lining; heat-treating furnaces; and precision machined components, shafts, fasteners, gears, castings, and forgings. It also offers single/multi-row pusher carburisng furnaces, rotary hearth furnaces, other heat-treating equipment and systems, and capabilities; and other heat-treating equipment and systems, such as conveyor mesh belt furnace lines, rotary retort furnaces, pusher furnaces for general applications, automation and handling systems, atmosphere systems, endothermic gas generators, and process control/ SCADA systems. The company serves original equipment manufacturers, as well as the automotive, agriculture, construction, utilities, and EV segments. Bharat Gears Limited was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BHANDARI.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited operates as a textile and garment manufacturing company in India. The company offers knitted fabrics kora and dyed; and knitted hosiery garments, such as t-shirts, pullovers, sweatshirts, bermudas, polo shirts, track suits, pajamas, lowers, ladies knitted tops with embroidery and prints, etc. It also manufactures, processes, and trades in dyed and non-dyed fabrics. In addition, the company provides natural and synthetic circular knitted fabrics; open and tubular width fabrics; and specialised finishes comprising teflon, stain resistance, viscose, and lycra. Further, it offers tees and leggings for women; t-shirts, sweatshirts, pullovers, and polos for men; and t-shirts, sweatshirts, pullovers, polos, and joggers for kids. The company also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ludhiana, India.

BHARATRAS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharat Rasayan Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of technical grade pesticides and chemical intermediates in India. It offers insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, and intermediates. The company also exports its products through multinational agrochemical companies and other traders. Bharat Rasayan Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in New Delhi, India.

BHARATWIRE.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharat Wire Ropes Limited manufactures and sells steel wire ropes in India. It offers wire ropes; slings, including mechanically spliced slings, hand spliced slings, mechanically spliced, and socketed slings; galvanized steel wire strands, such as earth wires, stay wires, and structural strands; and galvanized and ungalvanized steel wires. The company's products are used in elevators, cranes, general purpose, structural, fishing, oil and gas, shipping, mining, and logging and forestry. The company was formerly known as Bharat Ropes Limited and changed its name to Bharat Wire Ropes Limited in July 1996. Bharat Wire Ropes Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BHARTIARTL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharti Airtel Limited operates as a telecommunications company in India and internationally. It operates through the Mobile Services India, Mobile Services Africa, Mobile Services South Asia, Airtel Business, Passive Tower Infrastructure Services, Homes Services, Digital TV Services, and Others segments. The company provides voice and data telecom services through wireless technology including 2G/3G/4G/5G services; passive infrastructure service, including the setup, operation, and maintenance of wireless communication towers; mobile money services; home services covering voice and data communications through fixed-line network, wireless network, and broadband technology for homes; and digital TV services comprising digital broadcasting services under the DTH platform and IPTV services. It also engages in the airtel business that includes MPLS, VoIP, SIP trunking, fixed line voice solutions, communications platform as a service (CPaaS), internet of things (IoT), managed services, enterprise mobility applications, cloud, and cybersecurity, data and voice, network integration, managed services, security, and platform services. In addition, the company offers post-paid, prepaid, roaming, data services, OTT content, and various value-added services, as well as mobile TV, video calls, live-streaming videos, gaming, and high-definition (HD) and 4K content services. The company was formerly known as Bharti Tele-Ventures Limited and changed its name to Bharti Airtel Limited in April 2006. Bharti Airtel Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.

BHARATSE.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharat Seats Limited manufactures and sells seating systems and moulded carpets and extruded components for the automotive and surface transport industries in India. It offers seats for four-wheeler, two-wheeler, and railway chair cars; carpets; roof and windshield modeling products; and two-wheeler frame parts. The company also offers NVH components like floor carpet, silencer dash inner, silencer dash outer, motor cover under, fender lining, wheel housing cover for passenger cars; and design & development of rear doors for passenger cars. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Gurugram, India.

BHARTIHEXA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharti Hexacom Limited provides mobile services, fixed-line telephone, and broadband services to end consumers under the Airtel brand in India and internationally. It operates through Mobile Services; and Homes, Office and Other Services segments. The Mobile Services segment provides voice and data telecom services through wireless technology comprising 2G, 4G, and 5G networks; and offers intra-city fiber networks. The Home and Office Services segment offers voice and data communication services through fixed-line network and broadband technology for homes and offices. It also offers subscriptions for voice, data, messaging, and interconnection/roaming services, as well as other added value services. In addition, the company provides Connectivity and digital solutions for mobility, homes, business, as well as broadband, fixed-line, IPTV services. The company was formerly known as Hexacom India Limited and changed its name to Bharti Hexacom Limited in December 2004. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in New Delhi, India. Bharti Hexacom Limited is a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel Limited.

BHEL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited operates as power plant equipment manufacturer in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Power and Industry. It offers equipment supplies; spares and services; and undertakes engineering, procurement, and construction works for coal and lignite, gas, hydro and nuclear power plant, transportation, transmission, defence, aerospace, captive power plants, process, renewables, upstream and downstream oil and gas, e-mobility and energy storage, and other industries. The company also provides coal based, gas-based, nuclear, and hydro power plants, as well as solar power systems; rail, transportation and transmission systems; defense and aerospace products; industrial systems; and battery energy storage system and e-mobility solutions. In addition, it offers steam generators and steam generator auxiliaries, soot blowers, valves, piping systems, seamless steel tubes, valves, pressurized fluidized bed gasifiers, steam and gas turbines, turbo generators, industrial sets, castings and forgings, condenser and heat exchangers, pumps, Hydro Power Plants, compressors, and automation and control systems. Further, the company provides software system solutions, medium voltage vacuum switchgears, on load tap changers, LT switchgears and bus ducts, transformers and reactors, capacitors, bushings, control gears, insulators and ceramics, and electrical machines. It also provides rail transportation systems and equipment, defence and aerospace, oil field equipment, and fabricated equipment and mechanical packages. The company has a strategic collaboration with E2S Company Limited for the development of excitation systems for synchronous machines. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is based in New Delhi, India.

BI.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bilcare Limited provides pharmaceutical packaging research solutions in India and internationally. The company offers aluminum foils, polymer films, and anti-counterfeiting packaging solutions for solid dosage pharmaceutical products and other applications; and blister films and foils, lidding foils, CR foils, and laminates. It is also involved in the provision of clinical trial supplies, clinical trial management, and brand protection technologies services; and research and development services comprising formulation stability studies, blister/foil design and development, pharma brand innovation, analytical research and market study, and packaging trials and audit. Bilcare Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Pune, India.

BIGBLOC.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bigbloc Construction Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing, sales, and marketing of aerated autoclave concrete blocks in India. The company offers AAC wall panels, block jointing mortar, tile adhesives and gypsum plaster, and other construction chemicals. It markets its products under the NXTBLOC, NXTPLAST, NXTFIX, and ZMARTBUILD brand names. Bigbloc Construction Limited was founded in 2010 and is based in Surat, India.

BIL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bhartiya International Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and trades in leather and textile products in India. The company offers leather outerwear, bags, accessories, belts, wallets, fur products, and other small leather goods, as well as textile apparel, knitted and woven garments, sleepwear, puffers, jackets, non-leather bags, leather finishing; and design studio services. It also engages in the development of cities, homes, IT and industrial parks, retail spaces, interior solutions, and hotels and convention centers. The company exports its products. Bhartiya International Ltd. was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Gurugram, India.

BIKAJI.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bikaji Foods International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, purchases, and sells snack food products in India and internationally. It offers sweets, pellets, bhujia, namkeen, papad, chips, and other snacks, as well as frozen food products, gift packs, mathris, and cookies under the Bikaji brand. The company sells its products through general trade, supermarkets, hypermarkets, convenience stores and mini markets, wholesalers, and distributors, as well as online channels. In addition, it engages in the operation of quick service restaurant and café businesses, and retail stores; manufacturing and selling snacks under the InDine brand; contract manufacturing services for various third parties; and manufacturing, marketing, distributing, and selling of savory, samosa, naan, paratha, etc. Further, the company offers bakery products, such as croissants, breads, viennoiseries, cakes, pastries, doughnuts, brownies, and other bakery products. The company was formerly known as Shivdeep Industries Limited and changed its name to Bikaji Foods International Limited in October 2011. Bikaji Foods International Limited was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Bikaner, India.

BIMETAL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bimetal Bearings Limited manufactures and sells engine bearings, bushings, thrust washers, alloy powder, and bimetallic strips in India and internationally. The company provides crankshaft bearings/connecting rod bearings, thrust bearings, thrust washers; pre alloyed and metal powders, conrod and camshaft bush, and bimetallic strips; and battery packs. It also offers rocker levers, idler gears, and more; as well as ID-plated bushings. In addition, the company provides its products for passenger cars, MUVs, LCVs, M&HCVs, tractors, industrial engines, and two wheelers, as well as defense and railway establishments. It services automotive, defense, railways, agriculture, and services sectors. Bimetal Bearings Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Coimbatore, India.

BIOCON.NS.longBusinessSummary: Biocon Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures biotechnology products and offers research services in India, the United States, Ireland, rest of the European Union, and internationally. It operates through Generics; Biosimilars; and Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Organization (CRDMO) segments. The company offers generic formulations and API products, including cardiovascular, anti-diabetics, obesity, central nervous system, anti-cancer/oncology, multiple sclerosis, immunosuppressants, and specialty molecules; and biosimilars products for oncology, diabetes, and immunology therapeutic areas. It also provides integrated discovery, development, and manufacturing services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, animal health, consumer goods, and specialty chemical industries, as well as academic institutions, non-profit organizations, and government agencies. In addition, the company offers enzyme, biopharmaceutical, and medicinal goods; contract research and manufacturing services; clinical research; and business support and development, and marketing services. Biocon Limited was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

BIRLACABLE.NS.longBusinessSummary: Birla Cable Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of cables in India and internationally. The company offers wires and cables, lighting poles, solar energy systems and components trading, and fiber optic products and requisites trading.It also provides structured cable accessories, including patch cords, keystones, patch panels, faceplates, and connectors; telecom fibre accessories, such as adapter, pigtail, patch cord, fibre management, and joint closure; and fibre optic cables, including aerial, underground duct microduct, micromodule, FFTX, specialist, indoor products. The company was formerly known as Birla Ericsson Optical Limited and changed its name to Birla Cable Limited in September 2016. Birla Cable Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Rewa, India.

BILVYAPAR.NS.longBusinessSummary: BIL Vyapar Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it was engaged in the provision of media and publication services. The company was formerly known as Binani Industries Limited and changed its name to BIL Vyapar Limited in June 2025. BIL Vyapar Limited was founded in 1872 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BIOFILCHEM.NS.longBusinessSummary: Biofil Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of pharmaceutical products in India. It operates through Pharma and Chemical segments. The company offers basic drugs and chemicals, including sodium chloride, potassium chloride, sodium citrate, diethyl carbamazine citrate, ferrous sulphate, dried ferrous sulphate, ferrus fumerate, micro crystalline cellulose, and dicyclomine hydrochloride. It also provides ferrous sulphate in crystal, exsiccated, and granular form; microcrystalline cellulose powder; cellulose powder; calcium carbonate; and sodium chloride. In addition, the company offers job work facility for manufacturing of pharmaceuticals drug. Biofil Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Indore, India

BIRLACORPN.NS.longBusinessSummary: Birla Corporation Limited manufactures and sells cement and clinker in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Cement, Jute, and Others. The company offers ordinary Portland, Portland Pozzolana, and Portland slag cement under the MP Birla Cement Perfect Plus, MP Birla Cement Samrat Advanced, MP Birla Cement Ultimate Ultra, MP Birla Cement Unique, MP Birla Cement Samrat, MP Birla Cement Ultimate, MP Birla Cement Chetak, MP Birla Cement PSC, MP Birla Cement Multicem, and MP Birla Cement Concrecem brands used in bridges, dams, railway sleepers, reservoirs, industrial buildings, marine structures, cooling towers, metro lines, and airport runways. It also manufactures various jute products, such as jute yarn, floor and wall coverings, lino hessian, decorative fabrics, nursery cloths, scrims, jute carpets, non-woven jute felts, hydrocarbon-free bags/cloths, canvas, carpet backing cloths, which are used in mats, yarns, ropes, bags, carpets, and panama. In addition, It offers iron and steel castings. The company exports its products. The company was formerly known as Birla Jute Manufacturing Company Limited and changed its name to Birla Corporation Limited in 1998. Birla Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1919 and is based in Kolkata, India.

BIRLAMONEY.NS.longBusinessSummary: Aditya Birla Money Limited provides financial services in India. The company operates through three segments: Broking, Wholesale Debt Market, and Others. It offers stock and commodity broking; portfolio management services; depository and e-insurance repository solutions; and various financial products, as well as research and investment advisory services. The company was formerly known as Apollo Sindhoori Capital Investments Ltd and changed its name to Aditya Birla Money Limited in August 2009. Aditya Birla Money Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Chennai, India. The company operates as a subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited.

BIRLANU.NS.longBusinessSummary: BirlaNu Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes home and building products and services in India, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Roofs, Walls, Pipes and Construction Chemicals, Floors, and Others. It offers fiber cement, fortune fiber cement, ultracool fiber cement, and colored steel roofs, as well as leakproof sealing and structural support tools and accessories under the Charminar brand name; AAC blocks, panels, designer cement boards, and planks under the BirlaNu Aerocon brand name; and CPVC, uPVC, SWR, silent, UGD, foamcore, pressure, column, casing, PPR, HDPE, MDPE, gas pipes, electrofusion fittings, FHTC fittings, and water tanks under the BirlaNu Leakproof Pipes and Topline by BirlaNu Leakproof Pipes brand names. The company also provides wall putty and primer under the BirlaNu TruColour Putty and BirlaNu Primers brand names; bonding agents, waterproofing solutions, tile adhesives and grouts, epoxy and polyurethane coatings, anti-corrosion linings, and block joining mortars under the BirlaNu brand name; and laminates, engineered and resilient floorings, skirtings, and wall panels under the Parador brand name. In addition, it engages in wind power generation; and manufacturing of material handling and processing plant and equipment. The company was formerly known as HIL Limited and changed its name to BirlaNu Limited in March 2025. BirlaNu Limited was incorporated in 1946 and is based in New Delhi, India.

BIRLAPREC.NS.longBusinessSummary: Birla Precision Technologies Limited manufactures and sells machine tools and accessories, precision and automotive components, and castings in India, Japan, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Tooling, Automotive Components, and Other segments. The company offers tool holders, including collet, side lock, milling, shrink fit, dual taper, special, stub, extra gauge length, morse taper, turning tool, and mechanical holders; work and tool holding products; hydraulic and power grip milling chucks; production boosters; wooden box kits; boring bar adapters; jacobs tapers; drill chuck adapters; tapping systems; VDI shank tooling; reduction sleeves; shrink-fit heating machines; collets; and accessories. It also provides cutting tools comprising solid carbide drills, solid carbide end mills, twist and center drills, reamers, bore and shank type milling cutters, screwing taps, tools bits, engineering files, and grooving tools, as well as duratool products, consisting of hammer, masonry, and H series drills; annular cutters; carbide tip drills; steel files; ultra-thin and chopsaw wheels; depressed center discs; and TCT circular saws. In addition, the company offers ferrous shell casting products, such as bearing and turbine housings; braking; engine parts; fuel system shafts; o-ring carriers; drive shafts; end parts for metallic bellows; flanges; hydraulic spools; hydraulic actuator cylinders; rocker arm levers; halter; end yokes; crank shafts; fork selectors; machinery application; and turbocharger components for railways. It sells its products under the Dagger, Hathyar, Ninja, Panther and Carbomach brands. The company exports its products to Japan, Germany, the Czech Republic, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. The company was formerly known as Birla Kennametal Limited and changed its name to Birla Precision Technologies Limited in November 2007. Birla Precision Technologies Limited was founded in 1937 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BLACKBUCK.NS.longBusinessSummary: BlackBuck Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides payments, telematics, loads marketplace, and vehicle financing services in India. It operates in two segments, Truck Operator Services and Lending Business. The company offers digital solutions, including BlackBuck FASTag, GPS, Loads, Fuel Cards, and FinServe. It also engages in the provision of loans for the purchase of commercial vehicles; and logistics services. The company was formerly known as Zinka Logistics Solutions Limited and changed its name to BlackBuck Limited in August 2025. BlackBuck Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

BLACKROSE.NS.longBusinessSummary: Black Rose Industries Limited engages in the import, distribution, and export of specialty and performance chemicals in India and internationally. The company distributes a range of specialty chemicals comprising 8-hydroxyquinoline, alpha picoline, aniline, benzylamine, crude BHT, CTPI/PVI, diallylamine, diethanolamine, ethyl cyanoacetate, gamma picoline, homopiperazine, hydroquinone, meta-aminophenol, meta cresol, meta xylene, methacrylamide, monoethanolamine, n-methylpyrrolidine, neopentyl glycol, pentamethyldiethylenetriamine, purified isophthalic acid, pyridine, pyrrole, resorcinol, sulfolane, tetramethylethylenediamine, triethanolamine, and triallylamine, as well as n,n-diisopropylethylamine; and performance chemicals, such as anionic and cationic flocculants, cyanoacrylate adhesives, polymer additives, rubber chemicals, thermoplastic elastomers, epoxy hardeners, and salt tablets. It also manufactures specialty and performance chemicals; a range of organic coagulants, such as polyamine, polydadmac, de-coloring agents, and blends under the BRILTREAT brand; and polyacrylamide flocculants under the BRILFLOC brand for water and wastewater treatment. In addition, the company produces acrylamide liquids and acrylamide powders under the BRILMIDE brand; n-methylol acrylamide (NMA) under the BRILMER NMA brand; and fabrics and made ups for industrial applications. Further, it operates two windmills in Rajasthan and Gujarat. The company serves the agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, dyestuffs, petrochemicals, perfumeries, polymers, textiles, rubber, ceramics, water treatment, specialty chemicals, and other industrial sectors. It exports its products to Japan, Korea, the United States, and China. The company was formerly known as Asia Fab Ltd and changed its name to Black Rose Industries Limited in September 2006. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Black Rose Industries Limited operates as a subsidiary of Wedgewood Holdings Ltd.

BLAL.NS.longBusinessSummary: BEML Land Assets Limited engages in real estate business in India. It leases out properties in Bangalore and Mysore. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

BLBLIMITED.NS.longBusinessSummary: BLB Limited engages in trading and investments business in shares, and securities and commodities in India. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in New Delhi, India.

BLEL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Behari Lal Engineering Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of iron and steel products in India. The company manufactures metal rolls for rolling mills across various grades including alloy cast steel rolls, alloy steel base adamite rolls, graphitic steel rolls, S. G. Iron Pearlitic Rolls, S. G. Iron Bainitic/Accicular Rolls, alloyed indefinite chill rolls, and forged rolls used in rolling processes to produce finished steel products such as TMT rebar and structural steel. It also offers engineering castings in various grades for industries including steel, iron, mining and aggregate crushers, power, and sugar; carbon, alloy steel, tool steel, valve steel, and stainless steel bars in various sections such as rounds, round corner square, flats and hex, with different sizes; forging ingots and forged shafts/ blocks for application in industries, such as automotive, aerospace, oil & gas, energy, and heavy engineering. The company caters to industries such as automobile, steel, mining, infrastructure and construction, power, aerospace and defence, and cement. It sells its products in India, Afghanistan, Brazil, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, South Africa, Tanzania, Togo, Uganda, UAE, and the USA. Behari Lal Engineering Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Delhi, India.

BLIL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Balmer Lawrie Investments Limited engages in the non banking financial activities in India. It is involved in industrial packaging, logistic services and infrastructure, travel and vacation, greases and lubricants, chemicals, refinery and oil field, investment, and other businesses. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Kolkata, India.

BLISSGVS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bliss GVS Pharma Limited engages in the development, manufacturing and marketing of pharmaceutical formulations in India and internationally. The company offers anti-diabetic, anti-infective, anti-inflammatory, antifungal, antihemorrhoidal, antimalarial, antiseptic, cardiovascular, dermatological, gastrointestinal, gynaecology, neoro/cns, ophthalmic, otc drugs, respiratory, urology, and supplementary drug products, as well as engages in pain management services. It exports its products. Bliss GVS Pharma Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BLKASHYAP.NS.longBusinessSummary: B.L. Kashyap and Sons Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction and infrastructure development activities in India. The company constructs factories and manufacturing facilities, IT campuses, commercial and residential complexes, retail and malls, and institutions. It undertakes engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) projects to set up power generation plants, power transmission and distribution systems, integrated rail and metro systems, airports, hotels, residential buildings, townships, institutional buildings, industrial units, chemical process plants, water and wastewater management solutions, and hospitals, as well as in healthcare and transportation facilities. In addition, the company undertakes infrastructure projects, such as roads; metros; government related EPC urban infrastructure in health care, irrigation projects, power houses, railways, and other centres, as well as state related projects; and airports land and air side projects. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in New Delhi, India.

BLSE.NS.longBusinessSummary: BLS E-Services Limited, a technology enabled digital service company, provides assisted E-services and E-governance services in India. The company act as business correspondents to provide banking products and services on behalf of banks to people, such as opening savings, recurring deposit accounts, cash deposits, withdrawals, remittance, transfer, and bill collection services, etc; and value added services through BLS touchpoints, including PoS services, ticketing services, and assisted e-commerce services. It also operates a network of access points that offers delivery of essential public utility, social welfare scheme, healthcare, financial, educational, agricultural, and banking services to governments and businesses to citizens in urban, semi-urban, rural, and remote areas. In addition, the company offers E-Services through retailers and digital stores; and facilitate delivery of various e-governance initiatives of the State Governments in India by providing various information communication technology enabled citizen centric services. The company was formerly known as BLS E-Services Private Limited and changed its name to BLS E-Services Limited in April 2023. BLS E-Services Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Gurugram, India. BLS E-Services Limited operates as a subsidiary of BLS International Services Limited.

BLS.NS.longBusinessSummary: BLS International Services Limited provides outsourcing and administrative tasks of visa, passport, and consular services to diplomatic missions in the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, North America, Europe, Africa, South America, China, and India. It operates in two segments, Rendering of Visa and Other Allied Services; and Digital Services. The company offers visa processing, such as end-to-end outsourced visa application intake and processing; appointment scheduling and queue management; document completeness verification and quality checks; biometric data collection, including fingerprints and photographs; and secure transmission of application data to embassy/consulate systems. It also provides retrieval, consolidation, and dispatch of processed applications; and day-end reconciliation and reporting at Visa Application Centres. In addition, the company offers value-added services comprising courier and document delivery, form filling assistance, travel insurance, SMS and email alerts, lounge access, photocopy and print services, internet access facility, translation services, home biometrics collection, document attestation services, and applicant assistance. BLS International Services Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

BLUECLOUDS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Limited engages in design, development, and marketing of computer software in India and internationally. Its products include Access Genie, an AIoT-powered security response platform; BluHawk, a threat hunting solution; BluTact, a mobile device management platform; BluHealth, an AI-enabled healthcare screener and nano-bio sterilizer; EduGenie, an AI-based learning management system; and Blura, an automated news aggregation solution. The company offers managed IT solutions, including network monitoring and maintenance, server administration, desktop and mobile device support, data backup and recovery, security and compliance, and cloud and IT consulting services. It also provides security operations center services, such as 24/7 monitoring, incident detection and response, security device management, threat intelligence integration, vulnerability management, and security reporting and compliance services. In addition, the company offers cloud mitigation and software architecture services. The company was formerly known as Adithya Aquaculture Limited and changed its name to Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Limited in November 2015. Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

BLUECOAST.NS.longBusinessSummary: Blue Coast Hotels Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, the company was engaged in the hotel business. The company was formerly known as Blue Coast Hotels and Resorts Ltd. and changed its name to Blue Coast Hotels Limited in October 2009. Blue Coast Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in New Delhi, India.

BLUEDART.NS.longBusinessSummary: Blue Dart Express Limited provides courier and express services in India. Its domestic express portfolio includes time-definite delivery services, such as Domestic Priority 1030 and Domestic Priority 1200, and day-definite delivery solutions, including DP-Dox, DP Parcel, Air Express Package, Surface B2B, eCom Air, eCom Lite Surface, and eCom Surface. The company also offers air freight services between the airports of Chennai, Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad; ecom lite solution, a speed trucking solution; air express and ground express packaging services under the Smart Box name; express palette, a wood-free palletized packaging; shipment for freight of 50kg, 75kg, or above 100kg; door-to-door express deliveries for documents and shipments; international services; and temperature-controlled logistics solutions, as well as operates domestic express airline charter. It has a fleet of 6 Boeing 757-200 freighters and 2 Boeing 737 aircraft; and a fleet of e-vehicles in India. Blue Dart Express Limited was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Blue Dart Express Limited is a subsidiary of DHL Express (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.

BLUESTARCO.NS.longBusinessSummary: Blue Star Limited provides air conditioning and commercial refrigeration products, air and water purifiers, air coolers, cold storages, and specialty products in India. It operates through three segments: Electro-Mechanical Projects and Commercial Air Conditioning Systems; Unitary Products; and Professional Electronics and Industrial Systems. The Electro-Mechanical Projects and Commercial Air Conditioning Systems segment engages in the design, installation, and maintenance of central air conditioning systems, including packaged and ducted systems, variable refrigerant flow units, scroll and screw chillers, centrifugal chillers, and data center chillers. This segment also provides turnkey contracting services for mechanical, electrical and plumbing, and firefighting domains across buildings, factories, data centres, metro rail, and substations, as well as value-added services, such as retrofitting, system modernization, and ongoing operational support for the electro-mechanical systems. The Unitary Products segment is involved in the development, manufacture, and distribution of air conditioners for residential and commercial applications, as well as the provision of a range of commercial refrigeration solutions and air coolers. The Professional Electronics and Industrial Systems segment trades in and services testing machines, medical, analytical, test and measuring, data communications, and industrial products and systems. The company also exports its products to the Middle East, Africa, SAARC, and ASEAN regions. Blue Star Limited was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

BLUSPRING.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bluspring Enterprises Limited provides integrated facility management, security, food catering, telecom network, and client asset management services in India, Singapore, and internationally. It offers soft and hard services, pest control and landscaping, on-site and central kitchen, and event catering services. It also provides telecom and industrial services, such as installation and commissioning, digital consulting, network deployment, architecture and assurance, and tower infra management; and security services comprising manned guarding, electronic surveillance, background verification and training, and other services, as well as catering services. In addition, the company operates Foundit, an AI-powered talent and recruitment platform; and provision of candidate and recruiter services. Bluspring Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 2024 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

BLUEJET.NS.longBusinessSummary: Blue Jet Healthcare Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of artificial sweeteners, pharmaceutical intermediates and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for use in products. It provides contrast media intermediates, as well as end-to-end solutions from process development and commercialization of NCEs, advance intermediates, API, and building blocks. The company develops, manufactures, and markets saccharin and related supplies to healthcare, pharma, animal feed, and food and beverages industries. It has operations in India, Norway, France, the United States, Denmark, Thailand, Spain, Italy, Sweden, and internationally. Blue Jet Healthcare Limited was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Thane, India.

BLUESTONE.NS.longBusinessSummary: BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Limited designs, manufactures, and sells fine jewelry products under the BlueStone brand in India. The company offers rings, earrings, necklaces, pendants, solitaires, bangles, bracelets, kadas, studs, cufflinks, nazariyas, mangalsutras, nose pins, nose rings, nose screws, and chains; watch jewelry, including charms, bands, and pins; men's, kid's, platinum, gold, diamond, gemstone, and pearl jewelry; and gold coins. It sells its products through its franchise-owned and company-operated stores, website, and mobile application. BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BMWVENTLTD.NS.longBusinessSummary: BMW Ventures Limited engages in the trading and distribution of iron and steel products in India. It operates through Steel and Allied Products; Tractor Engines and Spares; PVC Pipes (Manufactured and Traded); Pre-engineered Buildings and Railway Girders; and Other segments. The company trades in and distributes TMT bars, GC sheets, HR sheets, wire rods, galvanised colour-coated sheets, GP sheets, hollow sections, pipes, and screws and allied products; distributes tractors, tractor engines, and spare parts; manufactures PVC pipes under the BMW Polytube brand; rents construction equipment; and fabricates pre-engineered buildings and railway girders. It also provides construction-equipment trading and hire; and job work/processing services, as well as residential and commercial doors and windows; hoes, shovels, sickles, crowbars, pickaxes, and hammers; and galvanized wires. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Patna, India.

BNALTD.NS.longBusinessSummary: B & A Limited, together with its subsidiaries, cultivates, produces, and sells black tea in India. It operates in three segments: Tea, Paper Sacks and Flexible Laminates. The company also operates tea estates. It also offers retail tea under the Gatoonga Tea Estate brand name. The company was formerly known as Barasali Tea Estate Limited and changed its name to B & A Limited in December 2000. B & A Limited was incorporated in 1915 and is based in Kolkata, India.

BOHRAIND.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bohra Industries Limited manufactures and trades in phosphate fertilizers in India. The company offers single super phosphate, granulated single super phosphate, and triple super phosphate. It engages in the trading of fertilizers, agro-chemicals, and industrial chemicals, as well as minerals, ores, metals, industrial materials, and related products. In addition, the company provides engineering, procurement, construction and consultancy services for industrial and infrastructure projects. Further, it is involved in power and renewable energy sector, including wind, and solar and captive power projects. It markets its products under the MAHALAXMI brand. The company also offers its products through a network of dealers. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Udaipur, India.

BODALCHEM.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bodal Chemicals Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of dyestuffs, dyes intermediates, and other chemicals in India and internationally. The company offers dye intermediates, including H-Acid, vinyl sulphone, K-Acid, gamma acid, DASA, FC acid, SPVS, OA, MPDSA, meta ureido aniline, and DIAZO; and dyestuffs, such as reactive, acid, direct, and liquid dyes. It also provides chemicals comprising of sulphuric acid, oleum, thionyl chloride, beta napthol, liquid SO3, PNA, chloro sulphonic acid, linear alkyl benzene sulphonic acid, and acetanilide. In addition, the company offers caustic soda, hydrochloric acid, hydrogen, chlorine, sodium hypochlorite, stable bleaching powder; and specialty chemicals comprising mono chloro benzene, para nitro chloro benzene, ortho nitro chloro benzene, meta nitro chloro benzene, and di chloro benzene. The company serves textiles, leather, paper, dye intermediates, dyestuffs, agrochemicals, aluminia, water treatment, detergents, food, and pharmaceuticals sectors. It also exports its products. Bodal Chemicals Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

BNAGROCHEM.NS.longBusinessSummary: BN Agrochem Limited operates as a fast-moving consumer goods company in India. It engages in manufacturing and trading of various kinds of edible oil, oil seeds, solvent extraction, extracted oil-cakes, and refined oil. The company was formerly known as BN Holdings Limited and changed its name to BN Agrochem Limited in August 2025. BN Agrochem Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Gautam Buddha Nagar, India.

BOMDYEING.NS.longName: The Bombay Dyeing and Manufacturing Company Limited
BOMDYEING.NS.longBusinessSummary: The Bombay Dyeing and Manufacturing Company Limited manufactures and sells polyester staple fibre products in India and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Real Estate, Polyester, and Retail/Textile. It offers polyester staple fibre and specialty products, including micro, optical white, dope dyed black, trilobal, hollow, spun lace, and high tenacity fibers, as well as textile grade PET chips. The company also engages in the retail of textiles and home furnishings; and development of real estate properties, such as residences, offices, hotels, serviced apartments, hospitals, schools, and retail. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1879 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BONLON.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bonlon Industries Limited manufactures and trades in ferrous and non-ferrous metals in India and internationally. It operates through Metal, Trading, and Manufacturing segments. The company offers copper wire rods for use in electrical and other engineering industries; and copper wires for use in power generation and transmission, power distribution, telecommunication, electronic circuitry, and electrical equipment applications, as well as offers cathode, ingots, and cables. It also deals in copper, aluminum, zinc, lead, nickel, etc.; and manufactures plastic insulated power cables. It also exports its cable products primarily to the United Arab Emirates and Nigeria. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in New Delhi, India.

BORANA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Borana Weaves Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of textiles in India. The company offers synthetic grey fabrics; yarn; microfilament woven fabrics; and greige polyester woven fabrics for apparel and garments, home textiles, and tent fabrics applications. Borana Weaves Limited was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Surat, India.

BORORENEW.NS.longBusinessSummary: Borosil Renewables Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of flat glass products in India and internationally. It provides low iron textured solar glass for various applications in photovoltaic (PV) panels, flat plate collectors, and greenhouses. It also offers 2 MM fully tempered solar glass; Shakti, a solar glass in matt-matt finish; NoSbEra, an antimony-free solar glass; Selene, an anti-glare solar glass; and solar glass with anti-reflective and anti-soiling, and grid printed back glass for bifacial, as well as solar glass for green house and roof tile applications. The company was formerly known as Borosil Glass Works Limited and changed its name to Borosil Renewables Limited in February 2020. Borosil Renewables Limited was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BOROLTD.NS.longBusinessSummary: Borosil Limited manufactures, sells, and trades in consumer ware products in India. The company offers laboratory glassware, including beakers, bottles, burettes, cones, condensers, cylinders, dessiciators, dishes, distilling apparatus, flasks, funnels, funnels, filtration assembly, volumetric flask, gas generator, jars, kettles, pipettes, tubes, HPLC VIALS, microscope slides, and lab accessories, as well as pharmaceutical packaging. It also provides consumer products, such as glass serve wear products, opalware dinner sets, kitchen appliances, storage products, glass lunch boxes, and stainless-steel vacuum insulated flasks and bottles, as well as solar glass. In addition, the company offers home decor, gas stoves, fine optical table wear, stainless-steel cookware, pressure cookers, kadai, frying pans, vacuum-insulated flasks. It provides its products under the Larah, LabQuest, and Borosil brand names. The company distributes through traditional crockery stores, modern retail outlets, e-commerce and quick commerce platforms, and website. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Hopewell Tableware Limited. Borosil Limited was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.

BOSCHLTD.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bosch Limited engages in the manufacture and trading of automotive products in India. It operates through Automotive Products, Consumer Goods, and Others segments. The company offers products, such as spark and glow plugs; ignition coil; nozzle holder, components, and fuel rail assembly; LAG, SAG, rotary drill, hammer, and marble cutter; impact drilling machine; fuel injection pump and components; blower; and machines and components. It also provides diesel and gasoline fuel injection systems; automotive aftermarket products; industrial equipment; electrical power tools; security systems; and industrial and consumer energy products and solutions. In addition, the company offers components and systems for internal combustion engines; develops thermal management systems; two wheeler and power sports; filters to batteries, lubricants, wiper blades, and diagnostic equipment and software; diesel systems, braking systems, auto electricals, and gasoline system products; trading activities in power tools and consumables; engages in hydrogen business; industrial and building technology products and services; and operates authorized workshops and service centers. Further, it supplies power tools and related accessories, garden tools, and measuring technology. Additionally, the company provides fire safety solutions. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1886 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Bosch Limited operates as a subsidiary of Robert Bosch Internationale Beteiligungen AG.

BOROSCI.NS.longBusinessSummary: Borosil Scientific Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of laboratory glassware. It offers glassware and consumables, including lab glassware, filtration products, and analytical vials; laboratory instrumentation for use in nutrition and environment, lab essentials, life sciences, and liquid handling; pharma primary packaging materials, such as glass ampoules and tubular glass vials; and laboratory process system, comprising mini reactors system; jacketed reactor; parallel reaction; automated reaction; photo and specialty; and utilities and accessories system. The company also provides Industrial Process Equipment and Original Equipment Manufacturing solutions. It serves the pharma, chemical, research, agriculture, food and beverages, and environment industries. The company was formerly known as Klass Pack Limited and changed its name to Borosil Scientific Limited in December 2023. The company was founded in 1962 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BPL.NS.longBusinessSummary: BPL Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells consumer electronics durable products in India. It offers televisions, washing machines, TV speakers and soundbars, refrigerator, air-conditioner, wireless products, cables and cords, fan, computer networking cables, party speakers, bluetooth neckbands, and headphones and headsets; single, double, and multi-layer printed circuit boards; and medical technologies. The company sells its products under the BPL brand. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Palakkad, India.

BPCL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited engages in refining crude oil and marketing petroleum products in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Downstream Petroleum; and Exploration and Production of Hydrocarbons. The company operates fuel stations that sell motor spirits, high-speed diesel, compressed and liquefied natural gas, automotive liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), and lubricants; operate convenience stores, restaurants, and electric vehicle charging facilities; and offer ATM, money transfer, insurance, and vehicle care services. It also provides LPG for domestic, commercial, and metal cutting gas under the Bharatgas brand name; automobile lubricants, such as automotive engine and gear oils, greases, and specialties, as well as industrial lubricants under the MAK brand; jet fuel; and aviation services, including transportation, storage, and intoplane services. In addition, the company offers industrial fuels products, white oils, bitumen and specialty bitumen, petcoke, sulphur, solvents, petrochemicals, bunkering, and petrochemical feedstock products; and operates pipelines to transport petroleum products. Further, it exports naphtha and fuel oils; and engages in city gas distribution activities. The company's marketing infrastructure includes a network of installations, depots, retail outlets, aviation fueling stations, and LPG distributors. The company was formerly known as Bharat Refineries Limited and changed its name to Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited in August 1977. Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

BOSCH-HCIL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bosch Home Comfort India Limited manufactures and distributes air conditioners, chillers, refrigerators, air purifiers, and variable refrigerant flow systems in India and internationally. It operates through Cooling Products for Comfort and Commercial Use; and Design and Development Services segments. The company offers inverter and non-inverter, fixed speed, split, non-inverter, hot and cold, packaged, window, and cassette air conditioners (AC); ducted and ductless air conditioners; centralized AC and room AC controllers; and water- and air-cooled screw chillers, and centrifugal chillers, as well as air quality solutions, and AC apps and controllers. It also provides wall mounted inverter and non-inverter AC; cassette AC; VRF systems; and after-sales services. It offers its products under the Hitachi brand for residential and commercial use. The company was formerly known as Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning India Limited and changed its name to Bosch Home Comfort India Limited in November 2025. Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning India Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Kadi, India. Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning India Limited operates as a subsidiary of JCHAC India Holdco Limited.

BRAHMINFRA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Brahmaputra Infrastructure Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an infrastructure company in India. The company operates through two segments: EPC Division and Real Estate Division. The company offers engineering, procurement, and construction services for infrastructure projects, such as bridges, flyovers, highways, airports, flood protection, building construction, and tunnel and mining projects. It also develops real estate properties, such as shopping malls, city centers, and industrial parks. Brahmaputra Infrastructure Limited was founded in 1987 and is based in Guwahati, India.

BPLPHARMA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharat Parenterals Limited engages in the research, development, manufacturing, marketing, sourcing, and distribution of pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. The company provides antibiotics, cardiovascular and central nervous system, antifungal, antimalarial, gastrointestinal tract/alimentary systems, analgesics, anaesthetics, quinolones, erectile dysfunction medicines, nutritional supplements, steroids and hormones, and other drugs. It also engages in manufacturing general products in capsules, tablets, ointment and creams, injections, oral liquids, and powder sachets forms; and beta lactum and cephalosporin products in capsules, tablets, dry syrup, and powder for injection forms. In addition, it offers research, development and manufacture of pharmaceutical formula ons, including sterile injectable products, oral liquid formula ons, prefilled syringes, other specialty, and eye drops. Bharat Parenterals Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Vadodara, India.

BRIGHTBR.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bright Brothers Limited manufactures and markets injection moulded plastic products for supplying to original equipment manufacturers for consumer durables industry in India. It offers composites, such as fiber reinforced polymer (FRP) and glass reinforced polymer (GRP); injection moulding, and extrusion moulding solutions, as well as provides paint shop services. In addition, it markets its products under the Brite brand for material handling crates; and hair brushes and beauty products under the DIVO brand name. Further, the company provides services, such as assembly services, surface finishing, ultrasonic & spin welding. It serves the home appliances and white goods, automotive and electric vehicles, fast-moving electrical goods, HVAC, railways, and electrical meters. Bright Brothers Limited was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BRIGADE.NS.longBusinessSummary: Brigade Enterprises Limited engages in the provision of real estate development, leasing, and related services in India. It operates through Real Estate, Hospitality, and Leasing segments. The company develops and sells various residential and commercial, and retail properties. It also manages star-rated hotels, clubs, and convention centres, as well as the Baking Company. Brigade Enterprises Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

BRNL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bharat Road Network Limited operates as a Build Operate-Transfer (BOT) company that owns, designs, develops, builds, operates, and transfers road and related services in India. It also engages in the development, implementation, operation, and maintenance of road and highway projects. In addition, the company provides project development and implementation; tolling operation and maintenance; highway management and development; claim and contracts management; and advisory and project management services, including construction supervision/debt syndication. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Kolkata, India.

BRIGHOTEL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Brigade Hotel Ventures Limited engages in the development and operation of hotels in India. The company is involved in the operation, management, and leasing of hotels. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Bengaluru, India. Brigade Hotel Ventures Limited operates as a subsidiary of Brigade Enterprises Limited.

BROOKS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Brooks Laboratories Limited operates as a pharmaceutical manufacturer in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Manufacturing and Trading. The company offers liquid injection ampoules and vials, dry powder injection vials, lyophilized injections, eye/ear drops, and nasal drops; and B-Lactam and cephalosporin tablets, dry powder syrups, and injections. It is also involved in loan-licensing business relating to pharmaceutical products, ingredients, and intermediaries; and trading in pharmaceutical products, ingredients, and intermediaries. In addition, the company offers oncology products and hormonal injections; and formulations for therapeutic areas comprising antibiotic, pain management, controlled drugs. It exports its products to Afghanistan, Yemen, Kosovo, Bolivia, Guatemala, Turkmenistan, Nigeria, Lebanon, Mauritius, Sudan, Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Angola, Mozambique, Latin America, and Africa. Brooks Laboratories Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BSE.NS.longBusinessSummary: BSE Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides a platform for the listing and trading of equity, debt instruments, currencies, commodities, derivatives, mutual funds, and small and medium enterprise securities in India and internationally. The company provides clearing and settlement, IT support, training, and stock exchange and index services, as well as engages in the corporate social responsibility activities. It also offers market data, risk management, data feeds, and investor education services, as well as operates as an intermediary for trading in overseas exchanges. The company was formerly known as Bombay Stock Exchange Limited and changed its name to BSE Limited in July 2011. BSE Limited was founded in 1875 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BSL.NS.longBusinessSummary: BSL Limited, a textile company, engages in the manufacture and sale of various yarns and fabrics in India and internationally. The company offers polyester viscose, worsted and cotton yarns, poly wool, vortex, and cotton yarns; and polyester viscose, worsted spinning, and fashion fabrics. It also provides suits for men; pure wool; and furnishings, including curtains, upholsteries, madeups, and silk fabrics. The company offers its products under the Geoffrey Hammonds, Geoffrey Hammonds Insignia, Unicare, and Basilio brand names. It also exports its products. BSL Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

BTML.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited engages in the production of content for television (TV), films, and digital platforms in India. It produces content across various languages, such as Hindi, Tamil, Marathi, Gujarati, and Bengali on TV and over the top OTT platforms; and compresses all genres such as drama, thriller, horror, comedy and lifestyle. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BSHSL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bombay Super Hybrid Seeds Limited engages in the research, production, processing, and marketing of hybrid and GM seeds in India. It provides various field and vegetable crop seeds, such as groundnut, coriander, sesame, maize, lucerne, fenugreek, wheat, onion, soybean, tomato, fennel, pigeon pea, watermelon, ajwain, beet root, paddy, isabgol, spinach, cucumber, pumpkin, lentil, carrot, okra, radish, cauliflower, cabbage, brinjal, bottle gourd, gram, bajra, gum guar, black gram, guar, green gram, hybrid sweet corn, cumin, jowar, peas, muskmelon, mustard, french bean, limabean, rajka bajri, chilli, bhindi/okra, cowpea, ridge gourd, sponge gourd, bitter gourd, castor, coriander, papaya, and drumstick seeds under the Kasturi and Bombay Super brands. The company also exports its products. Bombay Super Hybrid Seeds Limited was founded in 1983 and is based in Rajkot, India.

BUILDPRO.NS.longBusinessSummary: Shankara Buildpro Limited engages in retail, supply, distribution, and promotion of home improvement and building products in India. Shankara Buildpro Limited was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

BUTTERFLY.NS.longBusinessSummary: Butterfly Gandhimathi Appliances Limited manufactures and sells kitchen and small domestic appliances in India and internationally. It offers kitchen appliances, including liquefied petroleum gas stoves, mixer and wet grinders, electric rice and pressure cookers, chimneys, and power and built in hobs; and breakfast appliances, such as hand blenders and mixers, pop up toasters, sandwich makers, juicer mixer grinders, vacuum flasks, vegetable choppers, and water bottles. The company also provides electrical appliances comprising iron boxes, air coolers, washers, tower fans, electric kettles, and egg boilers; and non-stick cookwares and stainless steel utensils under the Butterfly brand name. In addition, it offers after-sales support services. The company was formerly known as Gandhimathi Appliances Limited and changed its name to Butterfly Gandhimathi Appliances Limited in December 2011. Butterfly Gandhimathi Appliances Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Navallur, India. The company operates as a subsidiary of Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Limited.

BURNPUR.NS.longBusinessSummary: Burnpur Cement Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, the company was engaged in the manufacture and sale of cement. Burnpur Cement Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Kolkata, India.

BYKE.NS.longBusinessSummary: The Byke Hospitality Limited operates in the hospitality business in India. The company operates hotels, resorts, and service apartments. The Byke Hospitality Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Mumbai, India.

BVCL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Barak Valley Cements Limited manufactures and sells cement and allied products in India. The company offers ordinary portland cement and portland pozzolana cement under the Valley Strong Cement brand name. It is also involved in mining limestone; and generation of electricity. The company serves individuals, contractors, builders, institutions, and government agencies. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in New Delhi, India.

CALSOFT.NS.longBusinessSummary: California Software Company Limited provides customized software, smart CRM and ERP tools, and robust enterprise solutions. It offers e-commerce website development services, food delivery app, pharmacy website development, billing software, WhatsApp automation, ERP solution, and restaurant POS. The company also provides marketing, ecommerce mobile app development, software product development, software architecture developments, mobile application developments, and SAAS application developments services. It serves healthcare, manufacturing, retail and ecommerce, real estate, education and edtech, and logistics industries. California Software Company Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Chennai, India.

CAMLINFINE.NS.longBusinessSummary: Camlin Fine Sciences Limited, together with its subsidiaries, research, develops, manufactures, and markets specialty chemicals, ingredients, and additive blend products in India and internationally. The company offers shelf-life solutions, which include basic ingredients, such as tert-butylhydroquinone (TBHQ), Butylated Hydroxyanisole (BHA), Butylated Hydroxytoluene (BHT), and Ascorbyl Palmitate (ASP); aroma ingredients, including vanillin and ethyl vanillin, natural vanillin, and some of its combinations; performance chemicals that include Hydroquinone (HQ), Catechol (CAT), Monomethyl Ether of HQ (MEHQ), tert butylcatechol (TBC), Guaiacol, and Veratrole; and health and wellness products comprising algae based products, such as Omega 3 fatty acids. It sells its products under the Xtendra, Nasure, Ezential, adorr, Vitafor, Dinamic, and Biosus brands. The company's products are used in food and beverage, pet food and rendering, animal nutrition, petrochemical, nutrition and health, biofuel, agrochemical, pharmaceutical, polymers, fragrance and flavor, and dyes and pigments industries. The company was formerly known as Camlin Fine Chemicals Ltd. and changed its name to Camlin Fine Sciences Limited in August 2011. Camlin Fine Sciences Limited was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

CAMPUS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Campus Activewear Limited engages in the design, manufacture, marketing, and distribution of sports and athleisure footwear, apparels, and backpacks for men, women, and children in India and internationally. It offers general-purpose sports shoes for fitness, exercising, walking, and light sports activities; and sneakers, sandals, slippers and open footwear across men's, women's and kids under the CAMPUS brand name. The company distributes its products through e-commerce platforms, distributors, and retail networks, comprising exclusive brand outlets and multi-brand outlets, as well as wholesale nework. Campus Activewear Limited was founded in 2005 and is based in Gurugram, India.

CAMS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Computer Age Management Services Limited provides registrar and transfer agency services, including data processing and related activities, to financial institutions in India. It provides MFCentral, a platform for mutual fund investors to digitally view their portfolios as well as manage and transact across their investments; myCAMS, a mobile app and portal for retail investors to manage and transact across multiple mutual funds; and digiLoan, which enables customers to avail digital borrowing against their mutual fund portfolios. The company offers edge360, a mobile app and portal for distributors and advisors, providing a platform for daily operations; GoCorp, a platform for corporate investors to transact across CAMS-managed mutual funds; CAMServ, a self-service chatbot to support investors with various financial and non-financial transactions; and eKYC, an OTP-based Aadhaar authentication solution that enables digital KYC. In addition, it provides CAMS WealthServ, a digital onboarding platform that offers paperless processing for alternate investment funds and portfolio management services investors; Think360.ai, which empowers BFSI enterprises with full-stack data science and AI solutions; and Bima Central, an insurance platform providing policyholder services, renewal reminders, a cover dashboard, downloads, and highlights.
