The company provides sector magnets for use in automotive magnetos and alternators; motor magnets for starter motors of automotive and motorcycles; ferrofluid-liquid magnets for applications in loudspeakers, electronic devices, mechanical engineering, aerospace, analytical instrumentation, biomedical, heat transfer-cooling, and display and education kits; and ring magnets for loudspeakers and lifting devices, etc. It also offers isotropic magnets for toys games and micro motors; low energy embedding powder magnets for use in bonded applications; and rare earth magnets that are used in electric vehicle drive motors, solar pumps, and drone motors. The company was formerly known as Delta Magnets Limited and changed its name to Delta Manufacturing Limited in October 2008. Delta Manufacturing Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.

DEN.NS.longBusinessSummary: DEN Networks Limited, a media and entertainment company, engages in the distribution of television channels to households through a digital cable distribution network in India. The company operates through two segments: Cable and Broadband. It distributes and promotes television channels; supplies set-top boxes and related equipment; and provides visual entertainment through cable TV, over-the-top entertainment, and broadband services, as well as offers internet services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

DEVIT.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dev Information Technology Limited provides information technology enabled services in India, Europe, and internationally. The company offers AI agent development, generative AI solutions, enterprise AI and automation, and AI governance services; cloud advisory and strategy, application modernization, managed cloud operations, and backup and disaster recovery services; data and analytics, modern workplace solutions, blockchain and Web3 solutions, and M365 migration services; data center support, managed digital workplace services, and cybersecurity services; custom software development, e-governance platforms, and mobile application development; and Microsoft D365 Finance and Operations, Microsoft D365 CRM, and business central. It also provides Talligence, a distinct AI-powered Tally BI tool for insights; and ByteSIGNER, a PDF document signing software. The company has a strategic alliance with Xduce Corporation. It serves information technology, financial and fintech services, real estate, construction and infrastructure, manufacturing, industrial and engineering, healthcare, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, retail, FMCG and consumer goods, education and learning, energy, utilities and sustainability, legal, audit and compliance, and travel, transport and logistics industries. Dev Information Technology Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

DENORA.NS.longBusinessSummary: De Nora India Limited manufactures, sells, and services electrolytic products in India and internationally. The company offers anodes for horizontal and vertical plating lines in Printed Circuit Board, metal winning and refining, periodic pulse reverse plating, steel electrogalvanizing, production of chlorate and chlorine, and trivalent chrome plating; cathodes for production of caustic soda; and electrodes for concrete structure cathodic protection, offshore cathodic protection, pool electrochlorination, and steel structure protection. It is also involved in the manufacturing and recoating of anodes and cathodes for electrolytic processes in the chlor-alkali industry. In addition, it provides Sanilec and Seaclor offshore seawater electrochlorination systems. The company was formerly known as Titanor Components Limited and changed its name to De Nora India Limited in June 2007. De Nora India Limited was founded in 1988 and is based in Ponda, India. De Nora India Limited is a subsidiary of Oronzio De Nora International B.V.

DEVX.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dev Accelerator Limited develops and licenses fully serviced office space and allied services in India and internationally. It also offers payroll and facility management; design and execution services; enterprise workspace designing and building, and custom software development services. The company serves large corporates, MNCs, SMEs, and startup. Dev Accelerator Limited was founded in 2017 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

DENTA.NS.shortName: DENTA WATER N INFRA SOL L
DENTA.NS.longName: Denta Water and Infra Solutions Limited
DENTA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Denta Water and Infra Solutions Limited, a water and infrastructure solution company, engages in the design, installation, and commissioning of water management infrastructure projects in India. The company provides groundwater recharging and construction projects in the field of railways and highways. It is also involved in the design, installation, commissioning, operations and maintenance of ground water recharging using recycled water; and operation and maintenance services for water management infrastructure projects. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

DEVYANI.NS.longBusinessSummary: Devyani International Limited develops, manages, and operates quick service restaurants and food courts in India, Nepal, Nigeria, Thailand, and internationally. It operates outlets under the KFC, Pizza Hut, Costa Coffee, Vaango and other brands. The company serves retail consumers for quick service food and beverages through dine in, takeaway, and delivery channels. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Gurugram, India. Devyani International Limited operates as a subsidiary of RJ Corp Limited.

DHABRIYA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dhabriya Polywood Limited engages in the manufacture and supply of poly vinyl chloride (PVC) and unplasticized poly vinyl chloride (uPVC) products in India. The company operates in two segments, Plastic Product and Modular Furniture. It offers uPVC windows and doors system, aluminum windows and doors; PVC doors, wall panel, fencing, furniture, and foam board; SPC flooring; wall and ceiling fluted panels; plywood soffit ceiling and wall system panels; aluminum windows and doors; and extruded PVC profile sections and sheets, as well as moldings for various furnishing and furniture applications. It also provides modular furniture products. The company sells its products under the Polywood, Dynasty, and D-Stona, Everluxe and Studio Arezzo brands. It exports its products. Dhabriya Polywood Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Jaipur, India.

DGCONTENT.NS.longBusinessSummary: Digicontent Limited operates as a digital media and content solutions company in India. The company offers digital news ecosystem, such as hindustantimes.com, livemint.com, and livehindustan.com that covers news, business, politics, lifestyle, entertainment, and current affairs. It also operates platforms, including HT Auto, HT Tech, Healthshots, and Mint Money that provides content across automobiles, technology, health and wellness, and financial market products. In addition, the company offers source for movie reviews and ratings website through www.desimartini.com; and photo library. It is also involved in the aggregation and creation of audio and multi-screen videos; distribution of in-house creative and niche celeb-based content to mobile and digital users; and operates an audio feed that plays music inside across various stores. In addition, the company engages in the dissemination of news, knowledge, information, entertainment, and content of general interest in English, Hindi, and any other language through various digital and economic media; and management of advertising time and space on its news websites. The company was formerly known as HT Digital Ventures Limited and changed its name to Digicontent Limited in October 2017. Digicontent Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in New Delhi, India.

DHANBANK.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dhanlaxmi Bank Limited provides various banking and financial services in India. The company operates through Treasury, Retail Banking, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, and Other Banking Business segments. It offers deposit products, including savings and current accounts, and term deposits; debit and credit cards; and loans comprising home, vehicle, commercial, education, green, and business loans, as well as loans against securities and properties. The company also provides forex, digital banking, investment, depository, safe deposit lockers, financial planning, and door step banking services, as well as online services that include online trading, customs duty, prepaid mobile/DTH recharge, and bills payment. In addition, it offers credit services, such as industrial and trade advance, import export assistance, agricultural assistance, and credit treasury bills; forex, import, and export services; and corporate salary. Further, the company provides non-resident Indians (NRI) banking services, such as non-residential external accounts, non-resident ordinary accounts, recurring and term deposits, foreign currency non-resident fixed deposits, and resident foreign currency, as well as money transfer services and NRI property loans; and micro and agricultural banking, and financial planning services. Additionally, it offers SME banking services, including working capital facilities, trade facilities, and capacity expansion services; micro credit and agri banking services; and trade finance, electronic bank guarantees, and liberalized remittance schemes. Dhanlaxmi Bank Limited was incorporated in 1927 and is based in Thrissur, India.

DHARAN.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dharan Infra-EPC Limited engages in the engineering, procurement, and construction business in India. Its projects include railways, roads, bridges, hydro dams, solar farming, waste to energy, housing, and various ports. The company was formerly known as KBC Global Limited and changed its name to Dharan Infra-EPC Limited in June 2025. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Nashik, India.

DHAMPURSUG.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells sugar and its byproducts in India. It operates in six segments: Sugar, Chemicals, Ethanol, Potable Spirits, Power, and Other. The company offers branded, white, and raw sugar; ethyl acetate; RS, ethanol, extra-neutral alcohol (ENA), and industrial alcohol; and country liquor. It also engages in the sale of petrol and agricultural products; and co-generation and sale of power using bagasse and molasses. In addition, the company operates co-generation facilities with a capacity of 108.50 megawatts. It serves the power, distillery, and chemical sectors; institutional clients, domestic wholesalers, retail consumers, and food and beverage businesses; oil marketing companies; end users and traders; country liquor manufacturers; and distributors. Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited was incorporated in 1933 and is based in New Delhi, India.

DHARMAJ.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dharmaj Crop Guard Limited engages in manufacturing, distributing, and marketing of a range of agro chemical formulations in India. The company's agro chemical formulations include insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, plant growth regulators, micronutrient fertilizers, and antibiotics to the B2C and B2B customers. It also manufactures and sells general insect and pest control chemicals for public and animal health protection applications; and offers crop protection solutions, and agrochemical active ingredients and intermediates. The company exports its products to Latin America, East African countries, the Middle East, and Far East Asia. Dharmaj Crop Guard Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

DHANUKA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dhanuka Agritech Limited operates as an agro-chemical company in India. The company offers herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and plant growth regulators in various forms, such as liquid, dust, powder, and granules. It also provides biological and efficacy enhancers. Dhanuka Agritech Limited was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.

DHATRE.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dhatre Udyog Limited manufactures and sells iron and steel products in India. The company offers TMT bars, rounds, squares, angles; and trading of billets, blooms, ingots, iron ores, etc. The company was formerly known as Narayani Steels Limited and changed its name to Dhatre Udyog Limited in May 2023. Dhatre Udyog Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Kolkata, India.

DHOOTTRANS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dhoot Transmission Limited operates as a manufacturer of wiring harnesses, automotive switches, electronic sensors and controllers, connectors, terminals, automotive cables, power cords, and related components. The company provides wiring harnesses for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, commercial vehicles, off-road vehicles, farm equipment, earth movers, medical equipment, and domestic appliances. It manufactures electronic sensors and controllers, automotive switches, connection systems, connectors and terminals, automotive cables, and power cords. The company offers electric vehicle products, including charging guns, inlets, off-board chargers, residual current devices, high voltage and low voltage wiring harnesses, and lithium-ion battery assembly, serving both internal combustion engine and electric vehicle segments. The company supplies its products to original equipment manufacturers in the automotive, medical equipment, and domestic appliances sectors. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Aurangabad, India.

DHRUV.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dhruv Consultancy Services Limited, an infrastructure consultancy company, provides design, engineering, procurement, construction, and integrated project management services for highways, bridges, tunnels, architectural, environmental engineering, and ports in India. The company engages in the preparation of detailed project report and feasibility studies for infrastructure projects; operations and maintenance works; project management consultancy services; and independent and authority's engineer, project planning, designing, estimation, traffic and transportation engineering, financial analysis, technical audit, structural audit, bridges inspection, and techno legal services. It serves ministry of road transport and highways, national highways authority of India, Maharashtra state road development corporation, Mumbai metropolitan region development authority, and government authorities. Dhruv Consultancy Services Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.

DIACABS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of cables and conductors in India. The company offers low voltage, high voltage, extra high voltage, control, solar, fire survival/resistant, communication, marine and offshore, single and multi core, and instrumentation cables. It also provides railway overhead conductors, including catenary/ messenger wire, jumper wire, copper magnesium/ bronze jumper wire, feeder wire and span wire, dropper wire and copper magnesium, and bridle wire; copper rods and wires; aluminium conductor steel reinforced, all aluminium conductors, all aluminium alloy conductors, and all aluminium alloy conductors steel reinforced; and speciality wires, such as electrical grade aluminium, electrical grade aluminium alloy, mechanical grade aluminium alloy, high conductivity and high temperature resistant aluminium alloy, and welding grade aluminium wires, as well as aluminium alloy for industry applications. In addition, the company offers t and d new age overhead conductors; medium voltage covered conductors; ECO Conductors; and TS conductor AECC conductors. It markets its products and solutions under the DICABS brand. The company serves power transmission and distribution, infrastructure, renewable energy, oil and gas, railways and transportation, real estate, industrial, manufacturing, metals and mining, cement, telecommunications and data centres, as well as utilities, power companies, PSUs, EPC contractors, infrastructure developers, and industrial customers. The company was formerly known as Diamond Cables Limited. Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

DHUNINV.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dhunseri Investments Limited, a non-banking finance company, invests in shares and securities in India, Singapore, and internationally. The company operates through Trading, Treasury Operations, Flexible Packaging Films, and Tea segments. The Trading segment engages in trading PET resin. The Treasury Operations segment holds treasury assets for capital appreciation and other related gains. The Flexible Packaging Films segment engages in manufacturing BOPET films. The Tea segment invests in tea manufacturing companies. The company was formerly known as DI Marketing Limited. Dhunseri Investments Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Kolkata, India.

DIAMINESQ.NS.longBusinessSummary: Diamines and Chemicals Limited manufactures and markets organic chemical compounds in India. It operates through two segments, Specialty Chemicals and Trading in Fruits and Vegetables. The company offers piperazine anhydrous, piperazine 68% solutions, triethylenediamine, ethylenediamine, monoethanolamine, diethylenetriamine, and polyamine-mix. Its products are used in active pharmaceutical ingredients and pharma-intermediates, specialty chemicals, agro-chemicals, resins, water treatment chemicals, petroleum production chemicals, and additives applications. The company exports its products. Diamines and Chemicals Limited was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Vadodara, India.

DIAMONDYD.NS.longBusinessSummary: Prataap Snacks Limited manufactures and sells packaged snacks in India and internationally. It provides chips, extruded snacks, namkeen, and pellets, as well as fryums, cakes, sweet snacks, and popcorn under the Yellow Diamond and Avadh brands. Prataap Snacks Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Indore, India

DIFFNKG.NS.longBusinessSummary: Diffusion Engineers Limited manufactures and sells welding consumables, wear plates and parts, and heavy engineering equipment for various industries in India and internationally. The company provides specialized and customized repairs and reconditioning services for heavy machinery and equipment. It also trades in anti-wear powders, welding, and cutting machinery. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Nagpur, India.

DICIND.NS.longBusinessSummary: DIC India Limited manufactures and sells printing inks and allied material in India. The company provides newspaper printing inks; gravure printing inks comprising lamination, and surface printing; solvent and water based flexo inks; specialty inks, including industrial, UV varnish, UV offset, and high-speed UV news inks; and offset printing, commercial, and packaging inks, as well as concentrates and food safe and low migration solutions. It offers lamination and solvent based adhesives. It serves newspapers, magazines, conversion agents, printing and packaging, and national and international printing and packaging establishments. The company was formerly known as Coates of India Limited and changed its name to DIC India Limited in August 2004. DIC India Limited was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Noida, India. DIC India Limited is a subsidiary of DIC Asia Pacific Pte Limited.

DIGIDRIVE.NS.longBusinessSummary: Digidrive Distributors Limited distributes retail goods through digital marketplaces in India. It operates through Trading and Publication segments. The company distributes consumer electronic products, including digital audio players, compact and portable music players, music bars, and mobile phones. It also publishes OPEN magazine, a weekly magazine for current affairs, public policy, and business and contemporary issues. In addition, the company provides media, printed materials printing, and marketing support services. It serves merchants and businesses. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Kolkata, India. Digidrive Distributors Limited operates as a subsidiary of Composure Services Private Limited.

DIGITIDE.NS.longBusinessSummary: Digitide Solutions Limited engages in business process management services and technology. The company provides tech and AI services, such as AI, data and analytics, cloud migrations, and infrastructure managed services; cybersecurity; data center; digital assurance, engineering, and experience; enterprise modernization and managed services; ERP services; GenAI solutions; IT consulting services; and low-code application platforms. It also offers business process services, including banking back-office operations, Digi CCaaS, collections, customer and employee experience management, and finance and accounting services. In addition, the company provides insurance data hub, an advanced data aggregation and analytics for the insurance sector; Pulse.ai, an AI-powered analytics and insights; integrated insurance platform (IIP), an end-to-end insurance; SmartHR, an AI driven HR management platform; SmartPay; Digital BPaaS, a business process transformation; and Sequre, a technology solutions tailored for enterprise needs. It serves the banking and finance, insurance, healthcare, fast-growth tech, auto and manufacturing, public sector, and other diversified industries. Digitide Solutions Limited was incorporated in 2024 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

DIGISPICE.NS.longBusinessSummary: DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited engages in the business of financial technologies services through tech- enabled hyper local payments network platforms in India. It offers cash-in/cash-out, mini-ATM transactions, and e-KYC-based account openings to money transfers; credit and loan services; insurance; and bill payments, as well as collection services, and current and savings accounts. The company also provides aadhaar-enabled payment system (AePS), cash management services (CMS), domestic money transfer (DMT), micro ATM, bharat bill payment system (BBPS), recharges, PAN, and travel services through Adhikaris; micro point of sale services (mPOS); subscription packs, remittances, credit distribution, and banking services; Spice UPI, a PPI wallet; and lending business that provide credit solutions to both merchants and consumers. In addition, it offers secured and unsecured lending products; digital financial and e-retail services across rural and semi-urban; and bookings for trains, flights, buses, and hotels through the Travel Union platform. The company was formerly known as Spice Mobility Limited and changed its name to DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited in August 2019. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Noida, India. DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited operates as a subsidiary of Spice Connect Private Limited.

DIGJAMLMTD.NS.longBusinessSummary: Digjam Limited engages in the manufactures and sells polyester viscose and pure wool fabrics for suiting and casual wear in India and internationally. The company offers its fabrics under the DIGJAM brand. Digjam Limited was formerly known as Digjam Textiles Limited and changed its name to Digjam Limited in March 2016. The company was founded in 1948 and is based in Mumbai, India. Digjam Limited operates as a subsidiary of Finquest Financial Solutions Private Limited.

DISHTV.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dish TV India Limited provides direct to home (DTH) television and teleport services in India. The company offers connected devices, such as Dish SMRT Hub and VZY Smart TVs; regional content; and value-added services. It also provides programming, live TV, and user-generated content through Watcho platform; FLIQS which provides films, web series, and short-form videos; and Zing Super Device, a two-in-one device that merges pay TV channels with a free-to-air package. In addition, the company offers B2B and technology services, including order management, Shopzop, teleport, and infra support services. Further, it provides set-top-boxes, dish antennas, and low-noise boxes; and customer-related services comprising call centre support and repair services. The company distributes its products and services through a network of distributors and dealers. It provides DTH services under Dish TV, Zing Super, and D2H brands. Dish TV India Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Noida, India.

DIVGIITTS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Divgi TorqTransfer Systems Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of transfer cases, automatic locking hubs, and synchronizers and components to automotive original equipment manufacturers and other customers. The company offers 4WD transfer cases, including mechanical shift, electrical shift-on-the-Fly, torque on demand, and dual-offset transfer cases; NexTrac Interactive Torque Coupler that senses the torque requirement and transfers the necessary torque to the rear wheels; manual, dual clutch, and electric vehicle transmission components; single, dual, and triple cone synchronizers; and transmission gears, clutch body rings, shafts, and electric vehicle transmission components. It serves customers in the automotive industry, including passenger vehicles, utility vehicles, commercial vehicles, and agricultural machinery. It operates in India, the United States, China, Mexico, the United Kingdom, Germany, Sweden, Thailand, South Korea, and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Pune, India. Divgi TorqTransfer Systems Limited is a subsidiary of Divgi Holdings Private Limited.

DISAQ.NS.longBusinessSummary: DISA India Limited manufactures and sells foundry machinery and machinery parts in India and internationally. The company offers moulding machines; sand mixers with the combination of sand plant equipment; and surface preparation machines and environmental control systems. It also provides vertical spot feeding, DISA Grind, automation solutions, including automatic core feeder, filter setter, and pattern changer; secondhand machines; and spare parts and services. In addition, the company offers Monitizer products, such as DETECT, used to keep machines running with early alerts, detailed diagnostics, and engineering insights that prevent downtime; CIM to Automate, sync, and control machine-to-machine processes; TAG that enables traceability and quality control into every single casting; MAC, which is used to capture high-precision mould data for pouring, measuring mismatch, gaps, steps, and parallelism; DISCOVER, for viewing production data and KPIs in real time; and PRESCRIBE. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India. DISA India Limited is a subsidiary of DISA Holding AG.

DIXON.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of electronic goods in India and internationally. The company offers display solutions, such as LED TVs, interactive flat panels, digital signages, and monitors; and lightning solutions, including special lamps, battens, bulbs, downlights, and strips and rope lights. It also provides home appliances comprising semi-automatic top loader and fully automatic top load; refrigerators; smartphones, foldable, and feature mobile phones; wireless wearables and hearables; computing devices; and telecommunication and networking products, which include 5G fixed wireless access devices, optical network terminals, and IPTV set-top boxes. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of electronic manufacturing services; trading; reverse logistics, such as repair and refurbishment of LED TV panels; repair of mobile phones; research and development; design and prototyping; manufacturing and assembly; and quality and performance. It exports its products. Dixon Technologies (India) Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Noida, India.

DLF.NS.longBusinessSummary: DLF Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the business of colonization and real estate development in India. The company is involved in the real estate development activities, including identification and acquisition of land, planning, execution, construction, and marketing of projects. The company also develops and sells residential housing projects, including under-construction projects. In addition, it operates and maintains commercial office spaces, as well as retail properties, such as malls, shopping complexes, recreational spaces, and hotels and clubs. In addition, the company engages in leasing, power generation, provision of maintenance services, and hospitality and recreational activities. Further, it owns and operates hotels under the The Lodhi and Hilton Garden Inn. The company was founded in 1946 and is based in Gurugram, India. DLF Limited operates as a subsidiary of Rajdhani Investments and Agencies Private Limited.

DLINKINDIA.NS.longBusinessSummary: D-Link (India) Limited engages in the marketing and distribution of D-Link branded networking products for small and medium businesses, residential users, and service providers in India and internationally. It offers home networking products, such as Wi-Fi systems, 4G/5G, cameras, smart home, switches, and adapters, as well as switches, wireless, nuclias, IP surveillance, industrial switches, and accessories. The company also provides Wi-Fi routers and mesh systems; unmanaged switches; security components, such as cables and SMPS; and mobile adapters, power strips, and versatile c-to-c cables. In addition, it offers switching, wireless, network management, network enclosures, and structured cabling solutions. The company was formerly known as Smartlink Network Systems Limited. D-Link (India) Limited was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. The company operates as a subsidiary of D-Link Holding Mauritius, Inc.

DJML.NS.longBusinessSummary: DJ Mediaprint & Logistics Limited provides integrated printing, logistics, and courier solutions in India and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Printing; Record Management Scanning and Logistics Services; and Other Business. It offers printing solutions, including variable data, continuous stationery, security, book, and magazine printing; bulk mailing; logistics solutions through air, rail, and road transportation, such as speed post, international courier, and moving services; and record and data management services comprising secured storage for business records, data tape storage and back up rotation services, and value items storage, as well as data entry, backlog scanning, and KYC verification. The company also provides newspaper print advertising; manpower supply; bulk SMS and emails; and bulk scanning services, which include off-site records storage, documents, scanning, rotation, evaluating and shredding. It serves banking, education, finance, lottery tickets, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, retail, stockbroking, telecom, utilities, and other, as well as airlines, shipping, and logistics industries. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.

DMART.NS.longBusinessSummary: Avenue Supermarts Limited engages in the business of organized retail and operation of supermarkets under the D-Mart brand name in India. The company offers food products, such as groceries, staples, processed food products, dairy, frozen products, beverages and confectionery products, and fruits and vegetables; non-food products, including home care and personal care products, toiletries, and other over the counter products; and general merchandise and apparel products comprising bed and bath products, toys and games, crockery, plastic goods, garments, footwear, utensils, and home appliances. It is also involved in the online and multi-channel retail of grocery and household products under the DMart Ready brand name; packing and sale of grocery products, spices, dry fruits, etc.; operation of food outlets and pharmacy stores; and development of land and construction. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Mumbai, India.

DNAMEDIA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Diligent Media Corporation Limited engages in the production, curation, creation, conversion, procurement, buying, selling, and distribution of various forms of multimedia content through digital media in India and internationally. The company's multimedia content includes digital news, videos, documentaries, and photo stories. It also provides content through DNA Syndication. Diligent Media Corporation Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Noida, India.

DIVISLAB.NS.longBusinessSummary: Divi's Laboratories Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of generic active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates, and nutraceuticals in India, North America, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company also undertakes custom synthesis contract manufacturing services of APIs and intermediates; and supplies a range of carotenoids, such as astaxanthin, beta-carotene, lycopene, canthaxanthin, apocarotenal, and vitamins used in the food, beverage, dietary supplement, pet food, and feed industries. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Divi's Research Center and changed its name to Divi's Laboratories Limited in 1994. Divi's Laboratories Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

DMCC.NS.longBusinessSummary: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells specialty and commodity chemicals in India and internationally. The company offers base, boron, functional, and life science chemicals. It also provides custom manufacturing and technology services. The company's products are used in agrochemicals, construction chemicals, cosmetics, detergents, dyes, electroplating, emulsions, fertilizers, fire retardants, ink, paper, pharmaceutical intermediates, pigments, polymers, textile processing, thermal paper coating, and water treatment. The company was formerly known as The Dharamsi Morarji Chemical Company Limited and changed its name to DMCC Speciality Chemicals Limited in October 2022. DMCC Speciality Chemicals Limited was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

DODLA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dodla Dairy Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of milk and value-added dairy products in India and internationally. The company offers flavoured, toned, standardized, full cream, ultrahigh temperature processed (UHT)-toned, UHT cow, and UHT-double toned milk; and milk products, such as butter milk, lassi, ghee, paneer, cheese, curd, flavored milk, yoghurt, butter, ice cream, and sweets. It also engages production and sale of cattle feed. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

DOLATALGO.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dolat Algotech Limited engages in the proprietary trading of shares, securities, commodities, derivatives, and other financial products in India. The company was formerly known as Dolat Investments Limited and changed its name to Dolat Algotech Limited in November 2021. Dolat Algotech Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

DOLLAR.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dollar Industries Limited manufactures and sells hosiery products in knitted inner wears, casual wears, and thermal wears in India and internationally. The company offers vests, briefs, trunks, gym vests, socks, tank tops, crew necks, polos, henley, bermudas, capri, track pants, and joggers for men; camisoles, panties, leggings, socks, leg wears, kurti, and casual wears for women; and T-shirts, socks, and trousers for children, as well as safety mask and personal protective equipment PPE kit. It also operates power generation unit sourced from windmill and solar energies. The company offers its products under the BigBoss, J-Class, Athleisure, Missy, Champion, Force NXT, Force Gowear, Pepe jeans, Lehar, Ultra, Wintercare, and Dollar Protect brands. It also exports its products to the United Arab Emirates, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Afghanistan, Nepal, Myanmar, Georgia, Sri Lanka, Somalia, Tanzania, Mozambique, Nigeria, and Kenya. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

DOLLEX.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dollex Agrotech Limited manufactures and trades in sugar and its by-products in India. It operates through Trading and Manufacturing segments. The company offers jaggery and Khandsari sugar; and by-products, such as molasses, pressmud, and bagasse. Dollex Agrotech Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Datia, India.

DOMS.NS.longBusinessSummary: DOMS Industries Limited designs, develops, manufactures, and sells stationery and art material products under the DOMS brand name in India and internationally. It offers pens and writing instruments; pencils and accessories; paper stationary; mathematical drawing instruments; markers and highlighters; gifting products; fine art; drawing and coloring; and crafts and hobbyist products. The company also provides baby diapers and wet wipes. In addition, it provides packaging services. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in Valsad, India.

DONEAR.NS.longBusinessSummary: Donear Industries Limited manufactures and sells fabrics in India and internationally. The company offers fabrics in various finishes, including wrinkle and odor resistance, moisture absorbent, and 4-way stretch; shirts, t-shirts, trousers, denims, suits, traditional wear, sports and jackets, corduroy, workwear, and accessories; and suiting and shirting fabrics under the Donear Suitings, Mayur Suitings & Shirtings, Ferrino Mizzoni, Eurico, Vestito, D'Cot, and Donear NXG brands. It also provides dyed polyester and cotton yarns; and trades in garments. The company exports its products to approximately 20 countries. It serves automotive, aviation, industrial, defence, government bodies, and educational institutions. The company sells its products through wholesale, retail, franchisees, agents, and dealers. Donear Industries Limited was founded in 1979 and is based in Mumbai, India.

DOLPHIN.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited provides offshore and marine services to the oil and gas industry in India. The company offers diving and underwater services, including underwater construction services entailing modification and redevelopment of existing offshore facilities; pre-engineering surveys; diving support for pipe laying and pipeline stabilization; inspection, maintenance, and repair of platforms; installation and replacement of tie-ins, risers, and conductors; underwater ship repair and maintenance; rig support diving services, including UWILD surveys; and inspection required for various certifying bodies. It also provides pre-engineering surveys, preparation of ISO's and bill of materials, transportation, and prefabrication of spools; onshore fabrication services; modifications on unmanned and process platform, installation of riser clamps and protectors, deck extension, boat landing, clamp-on structure, and running conductors; painting; hook-up and commissioning work; installation of walk-way bridges; replacement of cranes, FG skids, chlorinators, and deluge systems; piping works; structural works; and repairs to spud-can, mud-mats, and shock-pad foundation on jack-up rigs. In addition, the company offers pre-engineering, pre-construction, and post installation surveys of offshore structures/ pipelines; procurement of material and onshore fabrication; marine load outs, sea fastening, and transportation; installation of riser, conductor, i-tube, anodes and relocation of subsea clamps; diving and topside support; free span corrections; and design engineering services. Further, it provides floating/dry dock and in-situ emergency repairs; underwater repairs and maintenance; hull painting, plating, and piping and structural repairs and replacement; and engine repairs services. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Mumbai, India. Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is a subsidiary of Deep Onshore Services Private Limited.

DPSCLTD.NS.longBusinessSummary: India Power Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the generation and distribution of electricity in India. The company operates 24.8 MW of wind assets in Gujarat; 2 MW of solar asset in West Bengal; and 12 MW thermal power plants in Asansol, West Bengal. It serves government establishments, industrial houses, railways, and domestic consumers. The company was formerly known as DPSC Limited and changed its name to India Power Corporation Limited in August 2013. India Power Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India. India Power Corporation Limited operates as a subsidiary of India Power Corporation of India Ltd.

DPABHUSHAN.NS.longBusinessSummary: D. P. Abhushan Limited manufactures, sells, and trades gold, diamond, platinum, silver jewellery, and other precious metals in India. It also offers bars; gold and silver coins. The company was founded in 1940 and is based in Ratlam, India.

DRAGARWQ.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited engages in the provision of eye care and related services in India, Ghana, Uganda, Kenya, Madagascar, Tanzania, Rwanda, Zambia, Mozambique, and Mauritius. The company, through its hospitals, offers services in the areas of cataract, glaucoma, laser correction, cornea and refractive, retina, squint, corneal ulcer, fungal keratitis, diabetic retinopathy, retinal detachment, nystagmus, ptosis, conjunctivitis, retinopathy prematurity, macular hole and edema, cornea transplantation, behcets, computer vision syndrome, hypertensive retinopathy, black fungus, traumatic cataract, keratoconus, uveitis, pterygium, blepharitis, posterior subcapsular cataract, pinhole pupilloplasty, rosette cataract, and congenital glaucoma. It also operates opticals and pharmacies and is engaged in the sale of optical frames, contact lenses, accessories, and pharmaceutical products. Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited was founded in 1957 and is based in Chennai, India. Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited operates as a subsidiary of Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited.

DPWIRES.NS.longBusinessSummary: D.P. Wires Limited manufactures and supplies steel wires, plastic pipes, and plastic films for oil and gas, power, environment, civil, energy, automobile, infrastructure, and other industries in India and internationally. It operates through Wire Division, Plastic Division, Wind Mill Division, and Trading Division segments. The company offers LRPC strand wires, induction tempered wires, geomembrane sheets, and spring steel wires, as well as specialized steel wires. It also provides PE films, plastic films, pond lining films, HDPE films, cap covers, wires, and others. In addition, the company is involved in wind power generation and trading businesses. D.P. Wires Limited was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Ratlam, India.

DRCSYSTEMS.NS.longBusinessSummary: DRC Systems India Limited, a software development company, engages in the provision of information technology (IT) and IT enabled services in India, the United Arab Emirates, and internationally. The company offers web development, mobile application development, digital learning / e-learning, digital commerce / e-commerce, content management system, UI/UX design services, digital marketing services, and QA engineering and testing services; digital transformation services, such as application modernization, digital process automation, enterprise resource planning, product and platform engineering, agile consulting, and resource augmentation services; cloud strategy and consulting, managed cloud, cloud orchestration, and cloud infrastructure management services. It also provides artificial intelligence and machine learning, blockchain development; analytics and insights, and AI-powered chatbot and virtual assistants development services, as well as project management tools and blockchain-powered document issuing platform. In addition, the company offers Economic Zone Management System, a cloud & SaaS-based solution with single integrated system providing real-time insights on customer service, compliance, operation, and management for free zone, business parks, logistics, and economic zone. It serves education, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, public sector, and BFSI sectors. The company was formerly known as DRC Systems India Private Limited. DRC Systems India Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Gandhinagar, India.

DREAMFOLKS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dreamfolks Services Limited provides benefit management services through technology platforms that tailor airport and lifestyle service offerings in India. It provides airport and railway lounge access, meet and assist, golf access, spa, visa assistance and transit hotels, private club membership, airport food and beverage outlets, grooming, airport transfer, healthcare, buffets at hotels, room upgrades, and wellness services. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Gurugram, India.

DRREDDY.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated pharmaceutical company North America, Europe, India, Russia, and internationally. The company operates through Global Generics, Pharmaceutical Services and Active Ingredients (PSAI), and Others segment. Its Global Generics segment manufactures and markets prescription and over-the-counter finished pharmaceutical products that are marketed under a brand name or as a generic finished dosages with therapeutic equivalence to branded formulations, as well as engages in the biologics business. The PSAI segment manufactures and markets active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates, which are principal ingredients for finished pharmaceutical products. This segment also provides contract research services; and manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients and steroids with the customer requirements. Its Others segment engages in developing therapies in the fields of oncology and inflammation; and research, development, and commercialization of differentiated formulations. The company offers its products for various therapeutic categories, including gastro-intestinal, cardiovascular, anti-diabetic, dermatology, oncology, respiratory, stomatology, urology, and nephrology, vaccines, vitamins and minerals, and pain management. Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

DREDGECORP.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dredging Corporation of India Limited provides dredging services to various ports, the Indian navy, fishing harbors, and other maritime organizations in India. The company offers capital dredging, maintenance dredging, beach nourishment, land reclamation, inland/shallow water dredging, project management consultancy, hydrographic and survey services, and marine construction services. It operates through a fleet of 10 trailer suction hopper dredgers, one cutter suction dredger, one backhoe dredger, and one inland cutter suction dredger, as well as other ancillary crafts. Dredging Corporation of India Limited was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Visakhapatnam, India.

DSFCL.NS.longBusinessSummary: DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals Limited engages in the manufacturing and selling of chemical products and intermediates in India and internationally. Its Pharma products include D (-) alpha phenyl glycine base, D (-) alpha phenyl glycine ethyl potassium dane salt, D (-) alpha phenyl glycine chloride hydrochloride, D (-) para hydroxy phenyl glycine base, D (-) para hydroxy phenyl glycine methyl potassium dane salt, D (-) para hydroxy phenyl glycine methyl ester, DL 2-(2-Chloro Phenyl) glycine, valine hydantoin, sodium phenoxy acetate, phenoxy acetic acid, phenyl acetic acid, potassium phenyl acetate, sodium phenyl acetate, benzaldehyde, benzyl chloride, benzyl alcohol, benzyl benzoate, benzyl cyanide, ortho chloro benzaldehyde, ortho chloro benzoic acid, ortho chloro benzyl cyanide, ortho chloro phenyl acetic acid, para chloro benzaldehyde, para chloro benzoic acid, para chloro benzyl cyanide, and D(-) phenyl glycine methyl ester hydrochloride; Agrochemical products include benzaldehyde, benzyl Chloride, ortho chloro benzaldehyde, ortho chloro benzoic acid, ortho chloro benzyl cyanide, para chloro benzaldehyde, para chloro benzoic acid, para chloro benzyl cyanide, and para chloro phenyl glycine; Fragrance/Perfumery products include sodium phenoxy acetate, phenoxy acetic acid, phenyl acetic acid, potassium phenyl acetate, sodium phenyl acetate, benzaldehyde, benzyl alcohol, benzyl benzoate, and di-benzyl ether; Dyes/Paints/Coatings products include benzaldehyde, benzyl alcohol, ortho chloro benzaldehyde, and para chloro benzaldehyde; and Other products include sodium benzoate, di-benzyl ether, sodium sulphate, ammonium sulphate, phosphoric acid, sodium nitrate, and hydrochloric acid. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is based in New Delhi, India. DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals Limited operates as a subsidiary of DCM Shriram Industries Limited.

DSKULKARNI.NS.longBusinessSummary: D S Kulkarni Developers Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate development business in India. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Pune, India.

DSSL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Limited provides IT solutions and related services in India and internationally. It operates through System Integration and Technology Workforce Augmentation Services segments. The company offers system integration services, such as architecture, integration, and management of custom application and information infrastructures; and datacenter solutions comprising hyper converged infrastructure, server virtualization, software defined storage, enterprise backup and recovery solutions, data replication, DR automation, power and cooling, fire and safety, electrical and civil works, and physical access control solutions. It also provides workplace solutions, including design and development of mobility strategies, BYOD implementation integration and migration, monitoring management and end user support, MS infra management tools, IT asset management, secure virtual desktop, print services, unified communication, and workforce optimization; and network monitoring and management solutions, such as network monitoring of bandwidth utilization, network errors/collisions, network troubleshooting, day-to-day network operations, network performance monitoring, and tuning network operating systems. In addition, the company offers project management and execution solutions; and data center and network management, service desk, managed security, cloud, infrastructure management, IT staff augmentation, and vendor management services. Further, it provides security audit and vulnerability assessment; firewall design, deployment, and maintenance; intrusion detection and prevention systems; gateway security and management; enterprise anti-virus; SPAM and spyware; application and database administration; authentication and identity management; and CRM solutions. The company serves BFSI, healthcare/pharmaceuticals, enterprises, governments, and PSUs. Dynacons Systems & Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

DTIL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dhunseri Tea & Industries Limited engages in the cultivation, manufacture, and sale of loose and packet tea in India and internationally. The company produces and sells macadamia nuts. It also provides business management and consultancy services. The company was formerly known as Dhunseri Services Limited and changed its name to Dhunseri Tea & Industries Limited in February 2014. Dhunseri Tea & Industries Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Kolkata, India.

DUCON.NS.longBusinessSummary: Ducon Infratechnologies Limited, an engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) company, provides solutions in the fields of flue gas desulphurization (FGD) systems, air pollution control system, and material handling systems in India. It operates through the Industrial EPC and Security Solutions & AI segments. The company offers limestone, seawater, and dry sorbet injection type FGD systems for coal based power stations, which includes absorber towers, reagent preparation, gypsum handling, and associated balance of plant; bulk material handling includes belt conveyors, pipe conveyors, pneumatic conveying systems, silo systems and air slides for ash, coal, alumina and other bulk materials; and electrification and related infrastructure works supports grid expansion and rural development projects. It also provides air pollution control equipment such as venturi scrubbers, packed towers, multi-cyclones, electrostatic precipitators, bag filters, and carbon capture systems to manage particulate and gaseous emissions; offers industrial engineering services to various industries such as utilities, chemical, mining, petroleum, hydroelectric plants, aerospace, mining, steel, pulp and paper, cement, and other industries; and provides video security surveillance solutions through artificial intelligence. The company was formerly known as Dynacons Technologies Limited and changed its name to Ducon Infratechnologies Limited May 2016. Ducon Infratechnologies Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Thane, India.

DVL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dhunseri Ventures Limited engages in the treasury operations in shares and securities in India, Singapore, and internationally. It operates through Trading, Treasury Operations, and Flexible Packaging Films segments. The company is involved in the manufacture of BOPET film; trades in commodities and PET resin; and operations relate to holding treasury assets. The company was formerly known as Dhunseri Petrochem Limited and changed its name to Dhunseri Ventures Limited in December 2018. The company was incorporated in 1916 and is based in Kolkata, India. Dhunseri Ventures Limited is a subsidiary of Dhunseri Investments Limited.

DYNPRO.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dynemic Products Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of dyes and dye intermediates in India. It offers food colours that are primarily applied in foodstuff, beverages, animal feeds, etc.; lake colours for use in pharmaceuticals, cosmetic and personal care products, spice compounds, bakery and dairy products, and snack food applications; and blended colours. The company also provides food drug and cosmetic colors; salt free dyes for the inkjet industry; and natural food colours. and dyes intermediates, such as pyarazolone based dyes intermediates. In addition, it offers drug and cosmetic colours for tablet coatings, compressed tablets, syrups, hard and soft gelatin capsules, toiletries, skin-care products, water-based make-ups, lipsticks, nail polishes, pencils, foundations, and lip glosses. The company also exports its products. Dynemic Products Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

DWARKESH.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dwarikesh Sugar Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar in India. It is also involved in the co-generation and sale of power; manufacture of industrial alcohol, molasses, and ethanol; and production of hand sanitizers and liquid carbon dioxide. The company was formerly known as Dwarka Sugar Limited and changed its name to Dwarikesh Sugar Industries Limited in April 1994. Dwarikesh Sugar Industries Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.

DYCL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dynamic Cables Limited manufactures and supplies cables and conductors in India and internationally. The company offers 66 kV, MV, and LV unarmored aluminum cables; MV single-core aluminum armored and LV copper power cables; MV aerial bunched, LV aluminum multicore FRLS, LV copper armored, railway signaling, LV aerial bunched, UL, solar power AC/DC, and FR-LSH cables; MV covered, ACSR, bare copper, AL59, and AA/AAA conductors; and dynamic building wires. It serves government and private utility and distribution companies, EPC contractors, industrial sectors, solar projects, and railway systems. Dynamic Cables Limited was formerly known as Dynamic Engineers. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Jaipur, India.

DYNAMATECH.NS.longBusinessSummary: Dynamatic Technologies Limited manufactures and sells engineered products to the aerospace, automotive, and hydraulic industries in India, the United States, the United Kingdom, rest of Europe, Canada, and internationally. The company offers gear pumps, low noise pumps, high-pressure pumps, axial piston pumps, low torque high-speed hydraulic motors, plunger hand pumps, hitch control valves, rock shaft assemblies, power steering valves, and mobile control valves; and bespoke, high-flow scavenging pumps, lube oil pumps, and water pumps. It also provides high-precision airframe and aerospace components; control surfaces, such as wings, ailerons, fuselages, and doors; key flight-critical airframe structures, such as flap track beams; and intricate iron castings. In addition, the company offers geared motors; power steering units; construction equipment; and aluminium body, hydraulic gear pumps and motors from low to very high-pressure ratings, integrated gear and piston pump packages, and heavy duty compact cast iron gear pumps, and fan drive motors. Further, it provides unmanned aerial vehicles; engineering services; metallurgical ferrous castings; medical products comprising HCV rapid antibody test, viral RNA isolation, and DNA extraction kits; and laboratory services, such as testing and validation of products. The company was formerly known as Dynamatic Hydraulics Limited and changed its name to Dynamatic Technologies Limited in 1992. Dynamatic Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

EASEMYTRIP.NS.longBusinessSummary: Easy Trip Planners Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an online travel agency in India, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, Saudi Arabia, New Zealand, Brazil, and the United States. It operates through Air Ticketing; Hotels Packages; and Other Services segments. The company provides reservation and booking services related to travel and tourism through ease-my-trip portal and app or in-house call centre, which includes a range of travel-related products and services, such as airline tickets, hotels, and holiday and travel packages; and train and bus tickets, air charter services, taxi rentals, and cruise packages. The company also offers travel guides and updates, and other reservation activities; travel insurance, visa processing, and activity ticketing; and upskilling, professional, and vocational training services. Easy Trip Planners Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in New Delhi, India.

E2E.NS.longBusinessSummary: E2E Networks Limited provides cloud computing services in India. The company offers smart dedicated servers, graphics processing units, object storage, content delivery network service, and continuous data protection back up services. It also provides cloud GPUs, linux cloud, infiniband, storage and cloud solutions, containers and serverless, AI labs as a service, and sovereign cloud platform, as well as TIR, an GenAI Platform; and compute and infrastructure services. E2E Networks Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in New Delhi, India.

EASTSILK.NS.longBusinessSummary: Eastern Silk Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of textile products under the Eastern brand in India. The company offers drapery products, such as curtain sheer and drapes, curtain blackouts, embroidered, jacquard, printed, burnouts, plain, textured, blackouts, and other products; upholstery fabrics; beddings, including bed sheets, comforters, fitted sheet sets, quilted bed covers, pillow covers, duvet and duvet covers, and cushion covers; rugs; and textile accessories. It also provides made-ups comprising cushions, throws, curtains, bed scarves, etc.; and yarns, including cotton, linene, silk, viscose, chenille, acrylic, nylon, polyester, zari, and fancy yarn products. The company also exports its products. Eastern Silk Industries Limited was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

EASTWEST.NS.longBusinessSummary: East West Freight Carriers Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of logistics services in India and internationally. The company offers air, ocean, rail, and road freight services; project cargo services; and custom brokerage, warehousing solutions, and courier consolidation services. It also supplies temperature-controlled, time-sensitive goods, and services to the pharmaceutical, life science, and healthcare industries that includes packaging and handling, door to door, and last mile delivery services. The company was formerly known as East West Holdings Limited and changed its name to East West Freight Carriers Limited in July 2024. East West Freight Carriers Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.

ECLERX.NS.longBusinessSummary: eClerx Services Limited provides business process management, change management, data-driven insights, and advanced analytics services in North America, the United Kingdom, rest of Europe, and the Asia Pacific. It offers omnichannel customer support, customer journey mapping, quality monitoring, and field technical operations; digital marketing services, including omnichannel campaigns, creative production, product data management, MarTech enablement, search and media operations, and content and commerce services; and creative and content productions, such as photo/video management, post-production, 3D-CGI, VR/AR, digital workflows, and omnichannel delivery. The company also provides market intelligence services comprising digital shelf analytics, competitor intelligence, pricing intelligence, assortment optimization, product launch, revenue and yield management, and bid management; anti-money laundering, anti-bribery and corruption, fraud detection and prevention, know your customer, compliance monitoring and audits, and regulatory reporting; and data and cloud engineering, customer analytics, sales and marketing analytics, and care and support analytics services. In addition, it offers trade support, client lifecycle, asset servicing, settlements and clearing, lending operations, and data and document management; and procure to pay, order to cash, record to report, and specialty finance accounting, as well as digital transformation, strategic managed, and application development services. The company serves financial services, cable and telecommunications, retail, fashion, media and entertainment, manufacturing, travel and leisure, software, and high-tech industries. eClerx Services Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Mumbai, India.

ECORECO.NS.longBusinessSummary: Eco Recycling Limited operates as an e-waste management company in India. It is involved in the recycling of waste electrical and electronic equipment, as well as extract materials, such as copper, aluminum, silver, and gold from complex electronic scrap. The company also offers reverse logistics services; onsite and offsite data destruction services, including deleting, degaussing, and destroying data devices, which include hard drives, media tapes, flash drives, etc.; IT asset deposition; lamp recycling services; and battery recycling. It serves multi-national companies, corporates, retailers, bulk consumers, original equipment manufacturers, government departments, households, philanthropic organizations, educational institutions, and various other industries. The company was formerly known as Infotrek Syscom Limited and changed its name to Eco Recycling Limited in December 2010. Eco Recycling Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India. Eco Recycling Limited is a subsidiary of Ecoreco Ventures Private Limited.

EBIX.NS.longBusinessSummary: EBIX Limited provides software and e-commerce solutions for the insurance, finance, and healthcare industries. It operates through two segments: Insurance and Healthcare. The Insurance segment offers health insurance & employee benefits, property & casualty insurance, life insurance, risk compliance & management, lending, asset & wealth management, health content & wellness, travel & mobility, and EbixOne products. The Healthcare segment provides healthcare administration software, health exchanges, and related services. The company also offers services such as Payments, Travels, and EdTech & Insurance. The company also offers payment processing, risk compliance, and customer relationship management solutions. It serves insurance brokers, carriers, financial institutions, healthcare organizations, and businesses in India and internationally. The company was formerly known as Eraaya Lifespaces Limited and changed its name to EBIX Limited in June 2026. EBIX Limited was incorporated in 1967 and is based in New Delhi, India.

EBGNG.NS.longBusinessSummary: GNG Electronics Limited refurbishes, repairs, and sells laptops and desktops through its Electronics Bazaar brand in India and internationally. The company offers tablets, servers, premium smartphones, mobile workstations, and accessories. It also provides Information Technology Asset Disposition (ITAD) and e-waste management, doorstep service, and financing services; openbox, brand-new, and customised devices; value-added services, such as replacement warranty, on-site installation, upgrades, and buyback programmes; and workstations and other information and communication technology (ICT) devices. In addition, the company is involved in the general trading; and repair and refurbishment of laptop, phones, and information technology (IT) products. The company also has operations in the United States, Europe, Africa, Asia, and the Middle East. GNG Electronics Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Mumbai, India.

ECOSMOBLTY.NS.longBusinessSummary: Ecos (India) Mobility & Hospitality Limited provides chauffeured car rental and employee transportation services in India and internationally. It offers employee home-office-home ground transportation services; specialty vehicles, such as luggage vans, limousines, vintage cars, and vehicles for transportation of people with disabilities; car rental services; and self-drive car services. The company also provides corporate car rental, employee transport solutions, conference and delegation transportation, event transportation, hotel travel desk services, wedding car rental, and travel partners program services. It serves customers operating in a range of industries, including information technology, business process outsourcing, global capability centres, consultancy, healthcare, e-commerce, pharmaceutical, legal, and manufacturing. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in New Delhi, India.

EDELWEISS.NS.longBusinessSummary: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited, an investment company, provides financial products and services to corporations, institutions, and individuals in India. It offers credit products, such as home, small and medium-sized enterprise, and business loans; and investment banking services. The company also provides asset management, mutual funds, alternative asset advisory, asset reconstruction, asset resolution, and housing finance services. In addition, it offers life and general insurance products, and advisory services, as well as engages in lending, investment, and custodian and CSR activities. The company was formerly known as Edelweiss Capital Limited and changed its name to Edelweiss Financial Services Limited in August 2011. Edelweiss Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.

EICHERMOT.NS.longBusinessSummary: Eicher Motors Limited, an automobile company, engages in the manufacture and sale of motorcycles and commercial vehicles in India and internationally. The company designs, develops, manufactures, assembles, and sells two-wheelers, as well as related parts and accessories; motorcycle accessories; protective and performance gears; and lifestyle apparel products and accessories. It also provides motorcycle accessories; protective and performance gears; lifestyle apparel products and accessories; and parts and service support for riders across markets. In addition, the company owns the Royal Enfield motorcycle brand that offers Classic 350, Bullet 350, Meteor 350, Hunter 350, Himalayan 450, Scram 440 ADV Crossover, Interceptor 650, Bear 650, Guerrilla 450 modern roadster, Continental GT 650, Super Meteor 650, and Shotgun 650 models. The company was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.

EFCIL.NS.longBusinessSummary: EFC (I) Limited engages in the provision of real estate services in India and internationally. It operates through the Rental, Interior, and Furniture segments. The company engages in the development, buying, selling, leasing, operation, and management of managed office and coworking spaces; provision of turnkey interior design and execution solutions, as well as interior designing consultancy; manufacturing and supplying furniture for commercial and other spaces; and manufactures, sells, purchases, imports, and exports furniture and fixtures. It also provides property management and renting or leasing services involving its own or leased non-residential properties. The company serves entrepreneurs, small and medium enterprises, and enterprise clients. The company was formerly known as Amani Trading and Exports Limited. EFC (I) Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Pune, India.

EIDPARRY.NS.longBusinessSummary: E.I.D.- Parry (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar, ethanol, cogeneration, nutraceuticals, and consumer products in India, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers sugar for use in food, bakery, confectioneries, beverage, and pharmaceutical industries; and grains, such as millets and dals, as well as rice. It also provides nutraceuticals products, such as organic spirulina and chlorella, carotenoid, astaxanthin, and lutein and zeaxanthin; and distillery products, including extra neutral alcohol, ethanol, etc. In addition, the company offers generates and sells approximately 140 MW of power for state electricity grids and private energy. E.I.D.- Parry (India) Limited was founded in 1788 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.

EIFFL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Euro India Fresh Foods Limited manufactures and markets indian snacks and beverages products under the euro brand name in india. It chips, fryums, namkeen, khakhra, funfill, getmore, bhel, bhakhri, chikki, farali, mango pulp, indian sweets, freshly frozen pulp, celebration packs, as well as authentic indian breads and snacks including tandoor naan, punjabi samosa, and paratha. The company also provides fruit beverages, carbonated, and sparker energy drinks under the euro Fresho and Euro Lemoni names. The company also provides bakery and celebration products. In addition, it exports its products, as well as offers distributes through online grocery and retail platforms. Euro India Fresh Foods Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Mumbai, India.

EIEL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited engages in the design, construction, operation, and maintenance of water and wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) and water supply scheme projects (WSSPs) for government authorities/bodies in India. Its WWTPs include sewage treatment plants, sewerage schemes, and common effluent treatment plants; and WSSPs comprise water treatment plants along with pumping stations, as well as laying of pipelines for the supply of water. The company is also involved in engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) execution of renewable power plant projects; and sale of renewable energy. Enviro Infra Engineers Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Delhi, India.

EIMCOELECO.NS.longBusinessSummary: Eimco Elecon (India) Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of equipment for the mining and construction sectors in India. Its products include air motors, chair lift man-riding, coal haulers, drill machines, load haul dumpers, dump trucks, piling rigs, rocker shovel loaders, side dump loaders, and wheel loaders, as well as continuous miner package. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Vallabh Vidya Nagar, India.

EIHOTEL.NS.longBusinessSummary: EIH Limited, together with its subsidiaries, owns and manages hotels and cruisers under the Oberoi, Trident, and Maidens brand names in India and internationally. It is involved in flight catering, airport restaurants, project management and corporate, resorts, and air charters activities. The company also rents investment properties. EIH Limited was incorporated in 1949 and is based in Delhi, India.

EIHAHOTELS.NS.longBusinessSummary: EIH Associated Hotels Limited operates as a luxury hospitality company in India. The company offers hotel services, including accommodation, food and beverages, laundry, spa, guest transfer, membership, loyalty program, and other allied services. It operates the Oberoi Cecil hotel in Shimla and the Oberoi Rajvilas resort in Jaipur, as well as hotels under the Trident name in Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Jaipur, Udaipur, and Agra. The company serves individuals, groups and discerning travelers, corporate clients, travel agencies, and event managers. The company was formerly known as Oberoi Associated Hotels Limited and changed its name to EIH Associated Hotels Limited in November 1996. EIH Associated Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Delhi, India.

EKC.NS.longBusinessSummary: Everest Kanto Cylinder Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of high-pressure seamless gas cylinders and other cylinders in India, the United Arab Emirates, the United States, Hungary, and internationally. The company offers compressed natural gas (CNG) steel, industrial gas, fire extinguisher, fire suppression system, medical application, hydrogen, breathing air, aluminum, jumbo, and type-4 composite cylinders. It also provides equipment, appliances, and tanks with its parts and accessories used for containing and storage of natural gas and other gases, liquids, and air. In addition, the company is involved in the purchase and distribution of natural gas; and trading of fire extinguishment and related equipment, as well as castor oil. The company serves city gas distribution companies and CNG vehicle manufacturers. Everest Kanto Cylinder Limited was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India

EKI.NS.longBusinessSummary: EKI Energy Services Limited, together with its subsdiaries, engages in the provision of carbon credit offsetting and carbon advisory services, and implementation and development of carbon credit eligible projects in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Trading & Other Business, and Generation. The company offers sustainability and net zero services, such as AA1000 AS assurance providers by accountability, climate change, sustainability and ESG, sustainable supply chain, green certification and resource efficiency services; and community based projects, nature-based solutions, and ESCO energy efficiency projects. It also provides carbon avoidance and removal, extended producer responsibility (EPR), EPR credits, plastic credits, and green power/renewable energy attribute certificates projects; and offset portfolio management services, including operationalization of article 6 of paris agreement, carbon budgets and stock-take, and internationally transferred mitigation outcomes; and carbon offset, renewable energy attribute certificates, extended producer responsibilities, and plastic credits projects. In addition, the company offers comprehensive sustainability and ESG advisory services, such as greenhouse gas accounting, environmental, social and governance (ESG) strategy and reporting, carbon and climate risk management, life cycle assessment, biodiversity, regulatory compliance, and green building and product certification consulting; and net zero and decarbonisation roadmap development, science-based targets initiative target setting and support, reporting, carbon border adjustment mechanism advisory, business responsibility and sustainability report preparation, EcoVadis performance support, environmental product declarations, water footprint studies, green building certification consulting, and customized ESG capacity building and training programmes. EKI Energy Services Limited was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Indore, India.

ELANTAS.NS.longBusinessSummary: ELANTAS Beck India Limited manufactures and sells specialty chemicals for the electrical insulation and construction industries in India. The company operates through two segments, Electrical Insulations; and Engineering & Electronic Resins Solutions, and Materials. It provides wire enamels, such as primers, lubricants, and binder varnishes for fiberglass coated conductors; impregnating materials, including insulating varnishes and resins; and flexible electrical insulation materials. The company also offers casting and potting compounds comprising casting, potting, and encapsulation of electrical and electronic components, such as auto-electrical components, high-voltage insulators, instrument transformers, etc.; impregnation of high-voltage electrical machine windings; binder resins for glass-fibre filament wound arc chamber tubes; and diamond dotted paper for oil-filled transformers. In addition, it provides materials for electronic protection, including potting compounds, such as conformal, air drying resistant, rapid process acrylic, waterborne conformal, and silicone coatings; and thermal interface materials. Further, the company offers engineering materials, such as construction chemicals comprising a range of resinous construction chemicals for industrial floorings, protective coatings, structural repairs, waterproofing, adhesives, and sealants, as well as specialty epoxy and polyurethane anti-microbial floorings and wall coating systems; and reactive polyamides used in epoxy resins to produce top coats and primers, as well as thermosetting adhesives for a various substrates. The company was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Pune, India. ELANTAS Beck India Limited is a subsidiary of ELANTAS GmbH.

ELCIDIN.NS.longBusinessSummary: Elcid Investments Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in the investment in equity shares, securities, mutual funds and other financial instruments in India. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.

ELECON.NS.longBusinessSummary: Elecon Engineering Company Limited manufactures and sells industrial gears and material handling equipment in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Material Handling Equipment and Transmission Equipment. It offers helical and bevel helical, planetary, worm, wind turbine, marine, and custom-built gear boxes; and customized gear boxes, loose gears, and couplings.
