The company operates in two segments, Paper and Tissue, and Chemicals. It offers facial, toilet, napkin, kitchen towel, hand towel, maxi towel, and feminine and baby care tissue papers. The company also provides writing, printing, copier, sketching and drawing papers; education, envelopes and covers, lamination and absorbent kraft, and ice cream cone wrapping papers; and carry bags and cup stocks. In addition, it offers caustic soda, liquid chlorine, hydrochloric acid, bleaching powder, and sodium and calcium hypochlorite. The company was incorporated in 1936 and is based in Kolkata, India.

ORIENTHOT.NS.longBusinessSummary: Oriental Hotels Limited owns, operates, and manages hotels and resorts in India and Hong Kong. The company's hotel portfolio includes the Taj Coromandel, Chennai; Taj Fisherman's Cove Resort & Spa, Chennai; Taj Malabar Resort & Spa, Cochin; Vivanta, Coimbatore; Gateway Madurai and Coonoor; and Vivanta, Mangalore. It provides accommodation, restaurant, food, and catering services. Oriental Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Chennai, India.

ORIENTTECH.NS.longBusinessSummary: Orient Technologies Limited provides information technology services in India and internationally. It operates through IT Infrastructure Solutions; and IT Infrastructure and Application Services segments. The company provides IT infrastructure and technology services, such as infrastructure design, systems integration, data centres, cloud, hyperconverged infrastructure, software defined wide area networking, software-defined storage and virtual desktop infrastructure solutions. It also offers IaaS, PaaS, FaaS, DBaaS, storage as a service, as well as network as a service, security as a service, backup as a service, monitoring as a service, software as a service, content delivery network, and serverless computing solutions; and enterprise IT services, including infrastructure managed, break fix, managed print, cloud computing, systems integration, and applications development and maintenance services. In addition, the company provides managed services, such as monitoring, maintenance, and support of IT systems; multi vendor support; network operations centre services; and renewals of software licenses. Further, it offers data centre solutions that include servers, storage, active, and passive networking components; collaboration solutions for CCTV, virtual conferences, and meetings; and security solutions; as well as hyper converged infrastructure; virtualization solutions; and end-user computing that include desktop management, end-user support, and mobile device management. It serves BFSI, media, communication, healthcare, ITeS, manufacturing, government, infrastructure, real estate, logistics, education, e-commerce, conglomerates, energy, and service industries. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

ORISSAMINE.NS.longName: The Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited
ORISSAMINE.NS.longBusinessSummary: The Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited mines and markets iron ore and manganese ore in India. It produces and sells sponge iron. The company was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Bhubaneswar, India. The Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited is a subsidiary of Eastern Investments Limited.

ORKLAINDIA.NS.longBusinessSummary: Orkla India Limited operates as a food company, manufactures and sells spices and convenience foods in India and internationally. It offers instant food mixes, spices, masalas and blended curry powders; ready-to-eat food products, vermicelli, confectionery, beverages, coffee; and rice products, such as Puttu Podi, Idli Podi, Dosa Podi, Pathiri Podi, Appam Podi, and other products. The company also provides spices, pickles, tea, tamarind, coconut oil, and oral care products. It sells its products through e-commerce websites and commerce platform under the MTR, Eastern, Rasoi Magic, Wok N Roll, and Laban brand names. The company was formerly known as MTR Foods Private Limited. The company was founded in 1924 and is based in Bengaluru, India. Orkla India Limited is a subsidiary of Orkla Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd.

ORIRAIL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Oriental Rail Infrastructure Limited manufactures, buys, and sells various recron, seats and berths, and compreg board products in India and internationally. The company also provides compreg wood sheets used in electrical insulation, which include rings, blocks, and segments, etc.; silicon foam blocks and shuttering plates used in the manufacturing of seats and berths for railway coaches; acosonic boards used for architectural, thermal, and noise barriers solutions, as well as turnkey projects; lavatory doors; phenolic resins and hardners for plywood and moulded goods industries; artificial leather/rexine products under ORVIN brand used in shoes, automotive seating, commercial and residential upholstery, stationery, luggage and bags, and industrial and consumer applications; heavy equipment engineering, such as railway rolling stocks; and bogies, couplers, draft gears, and wagons. In addition, the company trades in timber woods, ferrous and non-ferrous metals, casting tools, slabs, rods, section flates, and other ferrous and non-ferrous products. Further, it exports its products. The company serves railways and other industries. The company was formerly known as Oriental Veneer Products Limited and changed its name to Oriental Rail Infrastructure Limited in March 2022. Oriental Rail Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.
